spec: Product rail 256 to 288 wide on a 2 to 4% tinted shell, no border. Head: 32px logo tile, workspace name 14/500, 12px plan line, up-down chevron. Rows 32 tall with 4 gap, 16px icons, 14px labels, 12px muted group labels. Footer: avatar, name, email.

Docs or reference rail 240 to 288 wide: search field with shortcut chip on top, 12 to 13px muted group labels, 14/400 rows at 32 to 37 pitch, chevrons on groups, bottom scroll fade. Current row filled: 6px radius, 5 to 7% ink or pale accent, weight 500.

Dark rail 280 wide on near-black, 1px divider at 10% white, 64px brand head. 12px muted group labels, 14px rows in second ink at 33 pitch, 15px solid glyphs. Active row 6% white, 6px radius. Switcher pinned bottom behind a rule; list fades under it.

Settings or enterprise rail: 14px rows 32 tall, 6px radius, 6% grey fill on the current row plus a 3 to 4px accent bar outside or flush with the fill. 12/600 muted group labels, 1px dividers between groups. Holds dense admin screens with many sections.

Open group reveals children indented 16px beside a 1px vertical guide at 8 to 10% ink. Rows 28 to 32 tall, 13 to 14px, chevron rotates 90 degrees in 150ms. Only the current branch stays open. File trees add 16px icons and 16px per depth.

Text-only docs rail with no fills: 13 to 14/500 group heads in ink, 13 to 14/400 items in muted ink at 26 to 42 pitch, active shown by ink or accent text alone, 1px right rule optional. Lowest chrome of the set, for short docs.

48px icon rail, 16px glyphs in second ink, 6px radius hover chip, active 2px accent edge, labels in tooltips. Use beside a second contextual panel in tools, or as the collapsed state of a 256 rail with its toggle at the bottom.

Second-level nav beside content, 160 to 256 wide: 14px rows 32 to 36 tall with 16px outline icons, tinted current row at 6px radius, small footer actions. Lists filters, saved views or in-page sections and sits inside the page under global nav.

Rail panel 332 wide holding a 16/700 title and round add button, then 8px-radius prompt cards one tone step up with 14/700 title, one line and a white 32px pill. Legal and language pinned at the base. The rail teaches before it has content.

Right column 296 to 380 wide beside main content: 14/600 section heads, key-value rows 13 to 14px at 24 pitch, 12px topic chips, small sparkline with count, 1px dividers. Facts only, no actions beyond a link.

Editor side panel 215 to 280 wide: search on top, collapsible 11 to 12px bold sections, grid of 26px tool glyphs or 13px label plus checkbox rows at 22 pitch, pinned more button. Flat, 1px dividers, no shadows.

Full app table: 40px head on 4% ink fill, rows 48 to 53, 14px cells, 1px rules at 8% ink, checkbox and action columns, status badges, 3% hover fill, 12px radius wrapper. Tabs or toolbar above, selection count and page controls below.

Quiet table with no outer box: 44 to 53px rows, 14/400 cells, 13 to 14/500 header, 1px rules at 8 to 12% ink only, no zebra, no vertical rules, numerals right aligned and tabular, optional bold total row in the footer.

Dense numeric table without rules: 36 to 40px rows, 14/400, alternate rows at 2 to 3% ink with 4 to 6px radius, 12/500 muted headers, 16px favicon plus name, right-aligned tabular numbers, one active sort arrow.

Wide comparison table: two-tier head on a tinted fill, 12/600 group row over 12/600 column row with 11px unit lines, vertical 1px rules only between groups, rows 40 to 45, 12 to 13px, 4x16 entity colour tab before the name, centred tabular numerals.

Ranked list where each label sits on a tinted bar scaled to its value: 36px pitch, 32px bar, radius 4, 10% tint, value right aligned at 14/500 in its own column. Bars stop short of the values. One tint per panel.

Editorial list on a shared column grid: 53px rows, 1px rules, 11px mono caps headers or none, 13 to 14px cells, bold title, long text fading on a 40px mask rather than an ellipsis. Hover draws an 8px-radius band outdented 16px past the rules.

Comparison table: first column 240 wide, parent rows 57 tall at 15px, child rows 45 tall at 13px, muted and indented 16px. Yes is a 14px filled disc with white tick, no a 10px thin x. Recommended column holds a 2% tint.

Reference table in mono 13 to 14px: 37 to 44px rows, dashed or hairline separators, right-aligned numbers, final price column bold, repeated names blanked so instances read as groups. Props version: 1px border, 6px radius, 12px muted header, type chips.

Stacked reference: mono 14px bold name, 12px muted type beside it, description 14 to 16px below, 1px rules between, nested child-attributes toggle. Better than a table when descriptions run to sentences. Pair with a bordered summary card in the right column.

List rows instead of columns: 16 to 40px leading icon or thumbnail, 15 to 16/500 title with inline 12px pills, 12px muted meta line, trailing counts. 64 to 96px tall, rules inside one 6 to 8px box, or separate hairline cards 8 to 20px apart.

Two-column ranked list: rank numeral, 20px logo, 14/500 name, muted owner, right-aligned volume and 12px delta coloured by direction. Sorted descending, no headers. Use on overview pages where the rank is the message.

Definition list for one record: 88 to 120px muted label column, 14px values, 12px row gap, items centred; status as a soft 12/500 badge, IDs in mono with a copy icon, links in accent. Use on detail pages instead of a two-column table.

Row states: hover 3 to 4% ink fill at 150ms; selected pale accent fill with a 2px left edge; a contextual bar replaces the toolbar with a count, bulk actions and cancel, in one strong fill so the mode is obvious.

Rows that open in place: 32 to 40px, chevron at left rotating 90 degrees, detail inset on a 2 to 4% fill with key-value pairs, height eased 200ms. Folder version uses 16px icons, 16px indent per depth, trailing commit line and time.

Status pills 20 to 22 tall, 12/500, 6 to 8px padding, full or 6px radius: subtle tint with dark same-hue text, or hairline with a 7px dot. Optional 12px icon or spinner. Colour maps to state only and the text always names the state.

Table ending: left a selection count at 13px muted, right a rows-per-page select, page N of M and four 32px icon buttons; or a centred numbered pager with 32px squares, 6px radius, current page solid. Tabular numerals so width never jumps.

Long table or code truncated: last two rows fade to page colour across 80px, and a 32px hairline pill with chevron overlaps the fade at centre. Keeps docs pages short without pagination. Reveal in place and keep scroll position.

Bar above a list with every control 32px: search field grows, then labelled filters with bold value, sort select, list or table view toggle, count at right, 8px gaps. Active filters show as removable chips with a clear-all.

Overlapping 24 to 32px circles, -8px overlap, 2px ring in the surface colour, trailing +N count on 6% ink at 12/500. Letter fallback is 11px initials on grey. Status dot 10px at the corner with the same ring.

Shell at 2 to 4% tint, 256 rail, main as a white inset card: 8px margin, 12px radius, hairline. 48px header with sidebar toggle, title, actions. 24px padding, 16px gaps: four KPI tiles, one chart card, tabs, table.

Black shell, 8px gaps: 332 library panel, flexible main, thin right rail, each one tone step up with 8px radius. 64px top bar sits on the shell. Only panels scroll, so the frame never moves. Suits media and consumer apps.

One 1088px column on faint grey: filter row, full-width chart card with KPI tabs, then pairs of 534px tabbed cards, 20px gaps. White cards, radius 8, tiny shadow, no border. No sidebar, because the report is the app.

KPIs as the chart's tab bar: 6 equal cells inside the card, 12/500 caps label, 18 to 20/600 value, 12px delta with arrow, 1px dividers, active cell 3% fill at radius 8. Clicking swaps the series below.

Four equal tiles, 16 gap, 1px hairline, 12 radius, 20px padding: 13px muted label, 28 to 32/600 tabular value, 12px delta naming its comparison period. Arrow shows direction, colour shows good or bad. Never more than 4 across.

Single 640 to 720 column: logo and subscribe, tinted banner with a 1px status border stating the state, one bordered panel of services with 90-day strips, then incident history. No nav, no sidebar. Readable during an outage.
Tool frame filling the viewport: 48px icon rail, main work pane, 350px side panel, top bar, status bar, 1px dividers, no shadows, 12 to 13px type, tabs per document. Each pane scrolls alone.

Query above and result below, or input left and output right, inside a 12px-radius panel: 150px sub-nav, ghost toolbar for split, add, time range and refresh, stacked panes with their own titles. Preview and JSON tabs on output. Stack on phone.

Panes in a hairline 8px-radius frame split by 1px rules, optional 12x16 grip on the seam, hit area 8px wider than the line, minimum widths to stop collapse. Each list scrolls inside with a thin overlay thumb and keeps its position.

Bar 48 to 56 tall: sidebar toggle, 16px hairline divider, 14px breadcrumb with muted parents and 500 current, actions right. Dark version uses 48px square icon cells. Add a second tier of 14px tabs only when sections need it.
Section tabs 40px high, 14/500 with 16px padding, or 12/500 caps inside cards. Inactive second ink, active ink with a 2px underline sitting on the row's 1px rule, so nothing jumps. Disabled at 40%.

Card with a header grid: 16/600 title and 14px muted description left, ghost action top right, 24px internal spacing, footer rule; small size uses 16px padding. Media version bleeds a 16:9 image at top. For settings and detail groups.

Reports page of 2 or 3 column chart cards with hairline borders, 14px title, source badge, export and table icons top right, shared palette and scales. Title states the metric or finding, and card heights align per row.
Fixed docs shell: 220 to 300 left nav, 640 to 720 content, 200 right page index with active heading in ink, 64px sticky top bar, 1px rule beside nav. Right column may hold a small promo card.

Design system page: each demo in a 1px bordered well, 8 to 12px radius, centred control, 48px show-code footer strip; anatomy diagrams with numbered pins and leader lines; do and don't pairs with 4px green or red top bars.

Layout grid with 1px guide lines between cells, plus marks at intersections, 13px cell numbers top left, dashed version, solid cells that clip the guides. For docs and landing sections that want a visible engineering grid.

Grid of 190px tiles with a generated gradient per item, 12 to 16px radius, white 16/700 title, small status pill, author and count footer at 12px. Colour comes from the item, so scanning feels like browsing. Expressive, not for data.

One metric over time: 2px line with straight segments, fill from 14% accent to clear, 1px grid at 5 to 8% ink, 12px tabular y labels on a nice scale from 0, 5 to 7 x labels, crosshair and tooltip on hover, 240 to 340 tall.

Stat above a minimal plot: 11px caps label, 24/400 value, 1px line with 6% fill fading to surface, dashed reference line, right axis at 10px with the reference value brightened, no gridlines. On dark, a black panel at radius 24. Label the threshold.

Ninety daily bars per service: bar 5 to 6px wide, 2 to 3px gap, 14 to 34 tall, radius 1. One calm fill, amber and red for incident days, grey for no data. Name left, uptime percent right, 90 days ago and Today at the ends.

Weekly bars filling their bands with 2px gaps, radius 2, single hue, right axis 12px, title plus range subtitle. Thin 44px area brush below with the selected window tinted. Current incomplete period drawn in grey, never as a drop.

Grid of 2 to 3 columns of small chart cards, one entity each: name or avatar, total, mini bars in one hue. Every panel shares the same y max and x range, so heights compare directly. Labels only at month starts.

Weekly stacked bars, 1 to 2px surface gap between segments, 4 to 5 series then Other in grey, legend above, 12px axis, linear or log toggle top right. Partial current period hatched above its real value. Keep series order stable.

Two overlaid areas in one ink at 30 and 60% fill, thin line on top, range segmented control top right, 12px dates. Add a y axis with values, which the source omits. Use straight or monotone segments, because smooth splines invent peaks.

Lines labelled on the plot, no legend: filled 12/600 chips on 1px vertical leaders into each curve, single pale axes, 11px caps axis titles. Highlight series dashed in accent with an open-ring terminus and a bordered note. State when schematic.

Vertical bars sorted descending, one entity per bar, 16 to 24px thick, 4px gap, hairline grid, 45 degree labels with logo, value on the cap. Colour follows the owner, so the same owner keeps its colour. New items get a small tag.

Two-measure scatter: 8 to 10px dots coloured by owner, direct labels on notable points, shaded target quadrant, dotted frontier line, 11 to 12px axis titles with units, log axis stated in the title, frontier toggle, table view.

One ratio or under 6 shares: donut with 60% inner radius, 2px surface gaps, 32/300 total in the centre, legend with percentages at the side; or a 12px semicircle arc over a grey track. Use ranked bars when values are close.

Hover card: surface fill, 1px hairline, 8px radius, soft shadow; 12px rows with swatch, muted label and right-aligned tabular value, date heading at 500. Crosshair 1px at 18% ink, dots 8px with a 2px surface ring. Flip near the right edge.

Chart container: 16 to 20px padding, 14 to 16/600 title left, unit subtitle, three 16px toolbar icons right for table view, expand and more, legend of 8px squares below the plot, 1px grid, footnote with source. White on a tinted page.

Monitoring panel one step above near-black: 1px bright line, 1px grid at 6% white both ways, 12px muted axes, 14/500 title, segmented chart-type toggle at right with active in accent text. Dense and unsmoothed.

Progress against a limit: 4 to 8px track at 10% ink, full radius, ink or accent fill, 14/500 label left and tabular value right above it. Width animates 500ms. Fill shifts to amber then red past thresholds; hairline ticks mark stops.

Rank over time: smooth curves across 5 to 6 named columns, one highlighted in ink and the rest pale, rank labels at left, category pills above. Curves are safe here because only order matters. Say rank, not value.

Share by area: flat tiles with 4px radius and 2px gaps, solid fills, white 12/500 labels only where they fit, value in the tooltip, grouped by category colour. For many small parts where exact comparison matters less.

Map inside a tabbed card about 480 wide: sequential tints of one hue from 10 to 100%, thin surface borders, places without data stay neutral. Tabs switch to a ranked list, which carries the exact values.
Trend beside a row: 110x30 line or area in one hue, no axes, inside a table or meta rail next to a count and a period label. The number carries the scale and the sparkline carries only the shape.

Label 13/500 above, 6px gap, input 36 to 40 tall, 6 to 8px radius, 1px inset line at 18% ink, 14px text, third-ink placeholder, 12px helper below. Focus: accent line plus 3px ring at 24%. 16 to 24px between fields.

Prefix, suffix and actions inside one 36px border: $ or icon at 12px inset, muted unit, trailing 28px ghost button, or tinted scheme addon with a divider. Focus ring wraps the whole group, never the inner input. Textarea adds a 12px footer line.

Enterprise field: 40px tall, 3 to 4% grey fill on white, 0 radius, 1px bottom border only, 12px label above, 12px helper below. Focus swaps to a 2px accent inset outline. Forms stack at 24px rhythm with square 48px buttons.

No box: one 1px ink or grey bottom rule, 12px label above or 18px placeholder, optional icon, 60px tall in hero search. Focus thickens the rule or shows a small cursor mark. For editorial and agency forms, never dense admin.

Two columns: 14/600 labels in a 190px column, 336px inputs at 44 to 48 tall, 1px border, 4px radius, focus 2px accent with a faint halo. Reads as a contract. Suits contact sales and long account forms on wide screens.

Dense tool form: mono parameter name plus type tag, 12px default hint below, or a 12/600 label cell on a one-step fill joined to a 32px input, 4px radius, two-up grid. Sliders pair with a number box showing min and max.

Invalid: 1px danger border plus 3px ring at 16%, 12 to 13px danger message with a 14px circled icon 6px below, replacing the helper. Validate on blur or submit, not while typing. Disabled is 4% fill and third ink with layout unchanged.

Track 32 to 48 tall, 6 to 14px radius, 4 to 7% ink fill, 3 to 4px inset; active chip in surface colour with hairline and 1px shadow, inactive second ink, no dividers. Equal widths to the longest label. Labels may carry a small saving chip.

White track with 1px hairline, 6px radius, 4px padding, 34 to 42 tall; active item 5 to 7% grey fill in ink, inactive second ink, no shadow. Full-width and icon-only forms with tooltips. The compact three-state theme switch lives here.

Page-level choice: 415x54 full-pill track at 7% ink, half-width thumb in solid ink with inverted 16/600 label, inactive 40% grey. Bigger than usual so it reads as scoping the page. Two or three options.

Attached items sharing one seam: 32 to 36 tall, 8 to 10px outer radius, square inner corners, 1px divider, active solid ink or 7% fill. Covers filter bars, split buttons and toolbars. Fit 2 to 5 items; icons 16px in 32px squares.

Track 28x16 to 44x24, full pill, accent when on, 7% ink off, white circular thumb with 1px ring, 140ms ease. Label sits 8px away and aligns to its first text line. A switch acts at once; use checkboxes in saved forms.

Settings card: 14/600 row title and 12px muted copy left, stacked 28x16 switches with 12/500 channel labels right, 1px dividers, 100 to 110px pitch, 24px card padding. Shows several decisions per row without a table.

Whole tile is the target: 70px tall, 6 to 12px radius, 1px hairline, 14/500 title, muted second line, 16px radio or checkbox at right. Selected: 1px accent edge, 7% accent fill, tinted text, filled dot. Hover 4% ink. 12px gaps.

16px box at 4px radius or circle, 1px line at 18% ink, checked solid ink with white tick or 8px dot, 14/500 label, 14px muted description, 8 to 12px gap, 12px between options. Focus ring outlines the box.
Row of 28 to 40 tall filters: active solid ink or 8% fill, others bare or hairline, 12 to 14px, count at right. Two taxonomies can use two chip styles. Scrolls sideways on phone with no wrap.

AI input as the page's centre: 640 wide, 20px radius, 1px line at 18% ink, 16px placeholder, foot row with add button, 32px mode segment, model select, mic and 32px solid send disc. Grows to 40vh; focus darkens the edge.

Composer pinned to the viewport base over docs: 576x62, 16px radius, 1px line, 15px placeholder, shortcut hint, 24px circular send. Article scrolls behind it, full width on phone. A flush square dock with blur suits fashion search.
Track 4 to 6px, full radius, 8 to 10% ink, range in ink or accent, 16px white thumb with 1px edge and small shadow. Label left, tabular value right, number box for exact entry. Range uses two thumbs.

Cost calculator: numbered steps, 36px tall radius 8 block slider filled solid ink to a thin grab bar with the value beside it, or a select that changes the price in place, estimate rail at right with boxed mono tags and right-aligned totals.

Trigger 36 tall with calendar icon and date or range; popover month grid of 32px cells, 14/400 numerals, selected solid ink at 8px radius, range as a 6% band with solid caps, muted outside days, ghost chevrons, presets at left.

Card 384 wide on a 4% tint, 14px radius, hairline, 24px padding: logo above, 20/600 title, muted line, 36px outline SSO buttons, or-rule, labelled 36px inputs, forgot link on the label row, solid 36px submit, 12px legal below.

Two columns: left an email and password stack at 36px with an outline SSO button, right a full-height image or product panel at 10px radius. Same control sizes as the rest of the app. Drop the panel on phone.

Six 36 to 44px square slots joined as one group, 1px hairline, 8px outer radius, centred tabular digits, active slot 2px ring, dash between groups of three. Paste fills all slots; submit on the last digit.

Read view is plain 14px text in a 32px row with 4% hover fill; click swaps to a bordered input with 24px confirm and cancel icon buttons floating bottom right. Esc cancels, Enter saves, errors replace helper text.

App button ladder 24, 32, 40: 14/500, 6 to 8px radius, primary solid ink or accent, secondary hairline, tertiary text, danger red. Loading keeps width and swaps the icon for a spinner. Cancel left of primary, 8px gap, right aligned.

Inline feedback: a 13px one-line question with four 20px faces in a 40px hairline pill or two 24px thumbs; a reaction reveals a textarea and a send button that stays disabled until input. Sits at page end.

Centred stack in a bordered 8 to 12 radius box, 48 to 64px padding: 54px hairline icon tile or 24 to 32px glyph, 16 to 20/500 title, 14px muted copy at 40ch, one action, optional link. No illustration, no fill.

Centred: 80 to 160px brand illustration, 20/600 title, 14px muted copy at 400px, 32px primary, secondary beside it, tertiary link. For first-run and permission errors in products with a real illustration system.
Left aligned on the page grid: 40/600 plain statement, 17px line, two equal 56px buttons 360 wide, 12px radius, 15px gap, hairline then a help line, promo tile below. The page stays a page.

Turns a dead end into navigation: 20 to 24/300 sentence, small caps label, stack of 66px bordered rows with thumbnail and name, 16px gaps, sticky full-width button at the sheet base, warm scrim behind.
Brand voice does the work: 40px display line in the site's own face, short friendly sub line, one pill or 34px button, about 48px gaps, no icon. For consumer carts and brand pages.
Keep the structure and fill one line: a table keeps its header and shows a centred 14/500 title with one 14px line and text link; rail groups show a half-alpha empty line. No icon, no card.
Blank work pane teaches the keyboard: 3 to 4 rows with label right aligned at 12 to 13px muted and keycaps left, then one outlined docs link. Centred, no headline. Tools only.

Nothing wrong is a result: tinted banner with a 1px status border, 16px check disc, 15 to 16/500 statement, white body line; or a card with a 24px check and 20/600 title. State carried by tint and words.

Placeholders that match the final layout cell for cell: flat 7% ink blocks, 6px radius, widths varied 40 to 80%, real headers kept, pulse to 50% over 1.6s, none under reduced motion. Layout must not shift when data lands.

Short waits stay in place: 16px ring or spoke spinner, verb label 14/500, tabular amount right, 48px hairline row; inside buttons the spinner replaces the icon and width holds. Respect reduced motion.

Inline note: 36px minimum, 6 to 8px radius, 16px icon, 14px text in dark same-hue ink on an 8 to 14% tint, never saturated; optional 14/600 title and trailing 28px action. Hairline version for neutral info.

Modal 640 wide at 18vh, 12px radius, hairline plus deep shadow, light scrim. Input 52 tall with 16px text, 12px group labels, 40px rows with 16px icon and right keycaps, 8px radius active fill, footer with result count and Enter action.
Same list embedded: 260 to 400 wide in a hairline 12px card, 32px grey search field inset 8px, 12px group labels, 32px rows with active fill, shortcuts right. For pickers and blank pages.

Search field that teaches its shortcut: 32 to 50 tall, 1px line or 3% fill, 6 to 12px radius, 14 to 15px grey label, two 18 to 20px keycaps inset right. Opens the palette. Swap the chip for Esc once dirty.

Menu 200 to 256 wide, 8px radius, hairline, soft shadow, 4px padding. Items 32 tall, 14px, 6px radius hover fill, 16px icon, right mono shortcut in third ink. 12/500 label, 1px separators at -4px margin. Destructive last in danger ink.
Same menu at the cursor on right click, with submenus, checkbox and radio items, opening in under 100ms. Mirror every item in a visible overflow button, because right click cannot be discovered.

Field 36 to 40 tall with magnifier and up-down chevron, popover matching its width, 32 to 36px options, 16px accent check at right, 11px group headers, empty message. Multi version shows 24px chips with an x inside the field.
Keycaps 20 tall, 11/500 mono, 5 to 6px padding, 4px radius, 6% ink fill or 1px line, no bevel, 3px apart. Use real glyphs for command, shift and return. Show Ctrl on Windows.

Centred 450 to 512 wide, 12px radius, hairline, deep soft shadow, scrim 40% ink. 18/600 title, 14px description, 20px padding, 36px fields at 16px gaps, footer rule, Cancel then primary right aligned. Focus first field, Esc closes.

Destructive confirm, 420 wide: 18/600 title naming the object, one sentence with the consequence, footer right with a soft fill keep button then a solid danger verb button. Focus lands on the safe action. No dismiss on outside click.

Drill-down table over the dashboard: 885 wide, 12px radius, 48px from viewport edges, 18/600 title with a 256px search naming the / shortcut, sticky header, zebra 36px rows, body clipped mid-row to show it scrolls, load more at the end.

Consumer notice: 393 wide, 32px radius, warm off-white, 40% scrim, 88px 3D object, 24/600 centred two-line statement, 48px full-width solid button inset 24px, small x. One fact, one action, shown once.

Commerce capture: 520 to 800 wide, photo half, logo, 32 to 48px offer line, one email field, solid button, quiet decline link, 40 to 50% scrim. Delay it past first scroll. Declining must be as easy as accepting.

Right panel 400 to 480 wide, full height, scrim 30 to 40%, 48px header with title and x, scrolling body, sticky footer action, slides in 240ms ease-out. Keeps list context. For record detail, carts and filters.
Phone sheet from the base: full width, 16px top radius, 32x4 grab handle, title, one primary and Cancel, max 90dvh, drag to dismiss. Centred dialogs should become this under 600px.

Bottom right, 356 wide, 10px radius, hairline, soft shadow, 13/500 title, 13px muted line, 16px status icon, optional 24px Undo. Stacks peek 12px at scale .95. Auto-dismiss at 4 to 6s, pause on hover, errors persist.

Near-black chip on light themes, 12/500, 6 by 10px padding, 6px radius, 8px rotated arrow, 4px off the trigger, 150ms fade with 2px slide, 300ms delay. One short phrase, no actions. Keyboard focus shows it too.

Card attached to its trigger: 256 to 300 wide, 10px radius, hairline, two-layer soft shadow, 16px padding, 8px offset, flips at viewport edges, 150ms fade and 4px slide. Hover cards wait 200ms. Holds detail, never a form flow.

Fixed bottom-right card 344 to 390 wide, 4 to 12px radius, 16px bold title, short plain copy, close x, decline and accept equally visible. Personality allowed, such as a cut-out figure breaking the corner. Never blocks the page.

Two equal actions and no default bias: 414x170, compact title, one line of explanation, two 48px keys side by side, either answer continues. For permissions such as sound or motion on entry. Focus ring on the first.

Page #08090a, panels #0f1011, raised #161718, controls #23252a, each about oklch L +.035. Borders white 8%, inner rules white 5%, no visible shadows. Text #f7f8f8, #d0d6e0, #8a8f98, #62666d. Overlap two panels and crop them at the frame.
Take the accent hue. Page oklch(.195 .034 h), panel .245 .042, tile .30 .046, rule .33 .04. Text .98 .005, .81 .03, .64 .035. No neutral grey anywhere, so the dark section stays inside the brand.

One full-bleed dark band, #101010 to #181818 or ink navy, mid-page on a light site, hard edges, 1 to 1.5 viewports tall. Rails and cell rules continue at the same x in white 10%. Reserve it for one proof.

Page #000, panels #101010, raised #1d1d1d, rules #262626 to #2e2e2e, fills white 5%. Text #fff, #a9a9a9, #777. No gradient on any chrome. Colour comes only from rendered content or one small accent on active states.

Warm dark steps sharing a faint yellow-brown cast: ground #141413, band #1f1e1d, raised #262624, borders #3d3d3a. Text #faf9f5, #b0aea5, #87867f. Steps of 5 L*. Cards may sit on #000 instead, as warm charcoal on black.

Full-bleed dark sections in a deep brand hue, oklch L .21 to .29, C .05 to .09, two hues at most. Headings take a light tint of the hue, body a muted tint, hairlines white 10 to 20%. Floods replace neutral dark mode.

Sections cut between white or stone and #0d0e12 to #1e1e1e with no gradient and no rule, 100 to 150px padding. Two or three grounds only. One illustration style or accent stays constant across flips, so rhythm comes from value.
One blue-grey hue at every step, oklch hue 255 to 280. Page L .17 to .23, C .02 to .05. Panels +.045, raised +.05 more. Rules white 8% or one step up. Body text is blue-grey too, never neutral grey.

Reverse the ladder: ground is the lightest dark, #16171d to #1c1c1c, and windows go darker, #07060c to #020202, so product reads as cut into the page. No shadows. Rules #2e2e32 to #333. Text #fff, 70%, 45%.
One or two flats only, #161616 to #1a1a1a and #333, with no borders, shadows or radius. Image and type supply everything else.

Keep the first two thirds light, then flip page, nav and banner to a dark brand tint, oklch L .2 to .25, C .03 to .05, for the final third. Cards one step lighter, borders white 10%, links a light tint of the accent.

Long dark page steps through four hard horizontal edges, oklch L .15, .18, .22, .27, about 2% each, in one slate hue, no gradients, then flips to warm paper. Measured #0c1114, #0f161c, #141d24, #212c36.

Full-bleed bands step #fcfbf8, #f9f6f1, #f3efe7, about 1.5 to 2.5 L* apart, oklch C under .012, no rules, no shadows, 100 to 140px padding. The colour change is the divider. End on a warm near-black footer.

Page #fafafa, raised sheet #fff, hover #f2f2f2, hairline #e6e6e6 or black 8%. Text #171717 and #4d4d4d. No tint, one accent at most, no shadow at rest. Separation is 2% lightness plus a line, so it feels printed.

Page #f7f7f4, panels #f2f1ed, controls #e6e5e0, ink #26251e, secondary text ink at 60%, hairlines ink at 10%. In oklch: L .975, .958, .921, C .004 to .007, hue 95 to 105. No shadows and no pure white.

Bone ground plus two or three flat colours, one pale tint, one saturated mid, one near-black ink, joined at hard edges with zero radii, borders or shadows. Each section is a single flat. The ink doubles as dark panel.
Four tones of the accent hue: oklch(.99 .006 h), (.965 .01 h), (.948 .007 h), (.90 .037 h). No shadow and no border. Depth comes from tone alone. Text uses a dark tint of the same hue.
One surface only: #fff, #fffdfa or #fefffb, with no cards, tints, borders or radii. Text black or near-black. Photographs and type supply all depth, butted directly against the page.

Section opens at page white and grades to a 6% darker tint over its height, or over the top 70px only, then ends on a hard edge at the next section. Soft in, hard out. No divider. Tint stays within 7 L* of white.

One plane, off-white or a single warm tint, #f2f3ed to #f7f6f5, and one ink. Everything else is that ink at 2%, 5% or 6% for fills and rules, no elevation, radii near zero. One accent. Flatness is the system, so alignment must be exact.

Cool ground #eef0f2 or #f5f5f7, pure white tiles, no border, one soft shadow or none. Text #1d1d1f, secondary #86868b. White reads as lit because the ground leans blue-grey, so put real product in the tiles.

Body background cross-fades between near-whites, such as warm grey, peach and pale blue, about .9s ease, as sections enter. Differences of 2 to 3 L* only. Nav tints with the page. No gradients on elements.

Full-bleed band 250px tall, skewed -12deg, clipped razor straight, filled with long blurred ellipses laid along it in four or five hues around the accent. Behind hero cards, bleeding off both edges, once. Soft inside, hard outside.

Full-bleed band 325 to 425px, hard top and bottom edges, ramp from page colour to an accent tint, low-frequency mottle of 3 to 4 levels, film grain sigma 4 to 5 levels masked to follow the colour. A stage, never page background.

Separate blurred ellipses, 44px blur, rise from the bottom edge to different heights, 150 to 540px, in four to six hues, with a near-white core at the very base. Fades to the dark page by mid-height. Grain sigma 3. Once, as payoff.

Rounded panel, radius 24 to 32px, container width, diagonal mesh of three pale hues held at one value, oklch L .84 to .87, C under .05. Dark app windows sit on it, cropped by the panel bottom. No grain, no shapes.

Repeating ramps that end in a hard cut: 130 to 420px vertical slats, or 10px blinds, or 8px barcode strokes. Amplitude 12 to 25 levels, faded at both ends by a mask. The ramp gives light, the cut gives material.

Page-colour disc about 90% of viewport width, hard edge with 18px soft spread. Outside it a conic gradient of three warm hues peaks at the rim and falls to page colour by the corners. Centre the falloff on the disc. Use once.

One page-tall vertical gradient, 4 to 8 stops, hue shifting per section. Sections have no edges. Cards sit on it as glass or white. Keep stops in one value range so text colour never flips. Chapters are marked by colour, like time of day.
Hero-only vertical gradient, saturated at the top, dissolving into page colour by 600 to 900px. Four to six stops, walking the hue. Stop before proof content, which sits on flat ground.

Flat neutral page, with colour reserved for one tile or one family of tiles: a grain mesh of two opposed hues, sigma 5 to 10 levels, white type, radius 16 to 30px. Reuse it once, enlarged. It becomes the only hue on the page.

On black or deep violet, soft diagonal bands at 25 to 35 degrees, about 200px wide, heavily blurred, two hues at most, fading to the ground at the edges. Optional 3px dot screen above. Behind hero and first product row only.
Full-viewport ground of large angled polygons, three or four pale tints within 6 L*, hard straight edges, a soft gradient inside each. Geometry replaces blurred blobs. Light UI cards sit on top.
A 150 to 320px tint behind header and H1 only, fading to page colour, peak within 8 L* of the ground. Or one 1px accent line with 150px of accent fading below it. Hero only.

evidence.name: Airpost: The Frontier Marketing OS for Frontier Companies

spec: Each section is one flat saturated colour, full-bleed, no gradient. Change colour at a hard edge, a wipe or a 1px hairline. Two to five hues per page, all of one saturation class. Type stays one colour or flips once.

Compress the brand gradient to a 24px hard-edged strip, a rule, or a 60px seam between image and field. Reuse the same stops behind titles at tint strength, so saturation steps down as content gets denser.
Deep gradient ground with 1 to 2px points or square pixels at 30% opacity, 20 to 40 per 1000px square, optionally a thin perspective grid at 15% white. Hero only, then return later as a flat strip.

One very large curved edge, 1px, lit from behind: a rim running through a spectrum, or a section lid brightening across its central 400px. Soft pool below 8% white, falling off within 100px. On black. Once per page.
Parallel diagonal bars in the accent, each a 100px ramp ending in a hard cut, blur 7px, masked by a radial into the dark page, in the top 500px only. The only saturated colour on the page.

A white streak on a card top border, 400px wide, 1px core, 24px halo at 60% peak, both fading at the ends, bleeding 12px above. Repeat once as a 1px light on the button rim. Black card, #262626 border.

One radial, 800 to 1400px wide, peak 9 levels above the ground on dark or a 6 to 10% tint on light, no visible edge, dithered with grain at .02 opacity. Gone by the fold, or by the next chapter on long pages.

All light belongs to the render: additive streaks, signs, rim fringes, soft shadow edges. No CSS glow over it. Background stays black or a flat floor. Bloom stays inside the image and falls to ground before its edge.

Elliptical radial about 780 by 400px of a warm tint fading to page colour with no edge, behind a centred CTA block on a light page. A focal point, not a wash. Keep the peak light enough for dark text.
Accent gradient rises from the bottom of a black frame behind the object and fades to black by 40% of the height. Used in a few shots only. Brand colour becomes light rather than UI.
Accent radial rises from one corner of a card, or from both top corners of a hero, gone by 40% of height, centre stays dark. Card: 1px tinted border, radius 12px. Hero: arched so copy stays on black.
A 2px accent outline around one product frame, 20 to 40px blurred outer glow of the same hue, deep tinted fill falling inward. One instance only, on a black page. It is the single saturated moment.

A large black shape with a hard silhouette masks an accent fill. Inside the shape, the accent blooms about 120px into the black. Hard outer edge plus soft inner light reads as a cut-out lit from behind.
A small 580 by 112px canvas between bio and work: a soft spectral ribbon that morphs, blurred at the edges, fading into the page at both ends. The only colour field on the page.
A 400px radial blur in the accent directly under frosted cards on #0a0a0a. Cards 60 to 80% opaque with white 1px edges. Light appears only where UI sits, never on empty page.

A 700px soft radial in a dark accent tint behind the media, revealing a 48px square grid only inside the glow. The grid is masked by the same radial and is gone before the viewport edge, so the copy side stays clean.
Where a dark hero meets a light page, a 6px solid tint line, then 30px fading to the page. A cheap, tidy join with no curve or image.

Canvas or WebGL point sheet, 8,000 to 100,000 points, 1 to 2px, grey or one hue, shaped as a soft tilted cloud or a real form. Density falls off, brightness does not. Slow drift. Behind low-content sections, over grain.

WebGL panel with slow two-colour noise, per-pixel grain at .045, optional 1px arcs at 30% alpha with small bursts where they cross. Inset radius 12px or full viewport. Body hue range under 40 degrees.
Canvas grid of 30 rows of square dots forming a low dome across the hero base. Near rows 4px, pitch 15px, far rows 1px, pitch 5px. Alpha .16 to .62, fading at crest and sides. A few accent points.
Extruded logo mark about 240px in pale stipple behind the headline, inside a field of 1px vertical bars at varied spacing, 10% grey, dissolving outward. Bars redraw on scroll.
Huge isometric blocks, flat shaded, two tones plus thin grid lines, rise from both bottom corners and crop off-screen, leaving the centre clear. The same units rebuild later as letters.
Full-viewport WebGL or video smoke, low contrast, one hue or grey, radial vignette to near-black, lighter centre, movement over six seconds or more. Content sits directly on it with no cards.
Canvas of grey letters from the brand name plus slashes, 8 to 24px, size implying depth, spiralling around the centre on a dark ground, thinning behind the heading. Slow rotation.
Real-time 3D sky with a deep-to-bright gradient, volumetric shafts and one glowing cloud mass in the foreground.

Solid column rails, dashed outer rails 40px out, horizontal rules that bleed past them, and a 6 to 12px white square or diamond node at every real crossing. All pale, 1px. The layout becomes the drawing.
Square grid 16 to 70px, 1px, about 16% white on dark or 6% on light, in one zone only and masked to nothing toward the copy. One solid object may break it. Cells can hold real stats.

Two 1px rails at about x=88 and viewport minus 88 run the whole page through white and tinted bands. Full-bleed rules at section ends meet them, stat cells connect into them, content sits 16px inside. Line colour 6 to 10% ink.

One-point perspective wireframe drawn from a vanishing point, back wall about a third of the viewport, rays plus frames on a perspective series, 1px #1c1c1c on near-black, small lattice dots, masked to 25% behind the headline.
Four or five 1px vertical guides on a 270px column, inner dashed, outer solid, about 6% ink, running nav to footer behind everything. Content actually aligns to them. Visible only in whitespace.
Page-wide SVG underlay: one or two circles 700 to 900px plus a few long diagonals or ellipses, 1px at 8% ink, cropped by the viewport. Fixed or slow. One arc may carry a travelling highlight.
Section ground with a 30 to 60px square grid, 1px, one shade from the ground, full bleed. Objects cast soft shadows on it. Translucent cards let lines continue through.
Three to five 1px rays fan from a rail corner across an empty band and land on the next section rule, or a few accent diagonals kink behind panels. Spacing becomes a drawn thing. Margins only.
Fixed sparse 1px lines or 3px plotted dots on a 100 to 400px pitch across the page, with 10px plus marks at intersections. Type overprints it. Reads as crop marks rather than a pattern.

Fixed 1px outlines of a technical drawing, or dashed isometric traces, at 6 to 15% alpha, scaled past the viewport, behind grey and black sections. Routes lead toward the central object. Ruled cells sit on top.
A 1320px frame of 1px rails. The 60 to 80px gutters outside hold contour line art or a dot grid at low opacity on every section. Interior stays clean, so the margins become the texture.
1px white 20% horizontal hairlines at nav base and mid-hero plus column ticks, drawn over full-bleed imagery to structure overlaid text rows.
The page field is a working instrument: thin accent lines from the centre act as a live clock or gauge, running off-screen, tied to a visible timestamp. One concept, one page.

A block edge breaks into 14px hard squares over 200 to 360px. Odds fall on a curve with a long tail, neighbours raise odds, so mass dissolves. No blur. A section boundary becomes the signature graphic.

Three or four flat 20 to 36px stripes in a ramped hue family, one continuous route with true concentric corners, passing behind the product and re-emerging. No gradient. A single signature, repeated small.

Monospace glyphs or square dots on a 6 to 7px cell, density modelling a lit form about 550px, bleeding off one edge on a flat ground. Take tone from a render or photo, not a flat silhouette. Reuse small as icons.

Dot matrix in the page, 1 to 2px dots on a 3 to 16px pitch, pale, only in gutters, seams and bands. White blocks sit on it and bite notches from band edges. Never behind copy. It replaces rules and background changes.

Concentric 1px offsets of one rounded shape, spacing opening quadratically, centre off-canvas, bleeding off one corner, masked to nothing toward the text. Retint per panel at about 30% ink. Moire near the edges is the point.
1px 45 degree hatch, 5px pitch, about 9% ink, filling 12px seams between double rules or 40px columns flanking content. Fine barcode lines at 6px pitch also work. Never under running text.
Rows of tracked 12 to 16px mono words or cipher text in faded tints at mixed opacity, dissolving at one side or masked into a ring, or letters set along spokes around a centre.
Canvas of 2 to 4px squares or dots, one hue, dense at edges and thinning into space, with small mono tags naming clusters. Keep it out of the text column and let it rearrange on scroll.
Empty grid cells hold 4px tinted rails with small star nodes at crossings, echoing the physical product grid. Fills gaps between images without adding content.
Logo geometry enlarged to 200 to 800px, drawn one tone from its ground, 3 to 5 L* apart, sweeping behind sections with its own corners. Replaces a generic gradient on dark pages and CTA bands.

Huge flat blobs, 100 to 400px or larger, hard edges, no gradient, cropped by viewport edges and straddling section breaks, tone on tone or one hue per feature. Riso grain optional. Behind UI, never behind body text.
Flat arches, circles and rectangles, 80 to 240px, in two to seven solid hues, cropped by edges, composed like a printed poster corner or a tile row beside photos. No gradients or shadow.
A section top cut in a repeating 100px scallop or a long wave, always matching the colour above. Use at both entries. Flat colour only.
Outlined shapes, real product or paper figures, 40 to 100px, 2 to 3px black stroke, scattered in side margins at varied rotation, moving at different scroll rates. Margins only.
A full-section pale line illustration, huge, on white, used as a scroll pause between content sheets.

Product stage, radius 24px, bleeding off one edge, pale to mid tint gradient under per-pixel stipple, sigma 9 on the pale side rising to 15 on the deep side. Show 30 to 40% of the stage around a white window, so it looks lit like a photo set.
Near-black ground #1c1c1c, grain sigma 6 levels, slightly lighter at screen edges. Panels above it stay flat #000 or #212121, so they look cut out. Never put running text directly on the grain.
Fine monochrome noise tiled over the whole page, multiply at .03 on light, hard-light at .04 on dark, barely visible at 100%. Runs under nav, sidebar and content alike.

Monochrome film grain over saturated gradients, sigma 4 to 7 levels, hard-light blend. One treatment across hero, tiles, CTA band and strips, so disparate pieces read as one material. Stops banding in deep hues.
Tiny dashes, dots, cipher characters or sparse stars, about 10% lighter than the ground, in cloud-like clusters across a large room or card header. Low enough to sit under 42px type.
Colour blocks share a low-contrast mottled paper or leather-grain image, about 3% contrast, so fills read as card stock. Use on tiles or panels, alternating with full-bleed photography.
An 80px band of 3px dots in the section hue sits within the frame rails where light meets dark, softening the join and adding a print detail.
Reduce one photograph to pure black and white dots with no greys, applied to masthead, cards and slices alike. Crop or glitch it on load. One treatment only.
Grainy stipple shapes, such as coastlines or contours, about 5% contrast against a grey ground, right of headings and behind quotes, bleeding off the rail. Visible before type on load.
Scanned dust, scratches, CRT scanlines or torn paper edges on a flat ground, denser toward the lower half. One era, one artefact. For fashion, culture and expressive briefs only.
A real repeating wallpaper tile or notebook grid, one shade from the ground, with a slight vignette. Blocks sit flat with no shadow.
Soft patches 8% darker than a flat cream ground, along the viewport top, about 200px deep, drifting slowly. The only atmosphere on the page, keeping type clean.
Real product objects tilted about 30 degrees, tinted one step off the ground, text at 50% of a dark tint, dissolving by mask toward the copy. Set in a panel with two soft blooms.
Rotate a photo 8 to 14 degrees, directional blur 70px along x and 2 to 3px across, boost saturation, add grain .09. Flat plates behind every demo and logo, radius 8 or square, hue varying per plate.

Eased black gradient over the lower 30 to 45% only, alpha stops 100, 86, 62, 34, 12, 0%. Headline and mono line sit inside the transition. The top of the frame gets no overlay, so the image keeps its luminance.

One image or drawing graded to the page colour, with uniform value behind the headline. Line art sits one step above the wash, and grain ties it together. Black or white type needs no scrim because the sky is even.
Tile is pure #000 with no CSS gradient. All light comes from the image, whose glow falls to black before its edges, so no rectangle shows. Export images on true black.

A material, sky or aerial photo, such as water, painted concrete or a dawn sky, used as a flat colour band 360px or taller with a title and CTA. Texture without a gradient, and no subject to compete with.
Full-bleed photo heavily blurred and graded to a near-black hue, about 10% visible detail, with grain. Reads as texture until you look. A sharp device or table sits on top with no scrim.
Photo band about 500px with a flat 45% dark or tinted scrim carrying a white headline and a rectangular CTA.
The page dissolves over its last 400px into a low-contrast cloud or fog photo, or a dark page lifts into fog and back, masked so no image edge shows. A panel or CTA floats in the air.
Film runs full-bleed, darkened to a brand navy. A 725px 1px white-outlined card, radius 20px, with no fill holds a letter. Footage shows through the text area, so it must be slow and dark.
Black linear gradient on the text side only, 60% at the edge to 0 by 35% of the width. Sky colour survives and white copy reads.
A painted or 3D world fixed behind a window UI, visible as an 8 to 150px frame around content. It never competes with the window.
A giant 600px monogram or pale map at 8% alpha behind dark sections, cropped by an edge or a curved horizon, always below text.
An inner photo sits inside an inset frame of the same image, blurred and scaled, with about a 30px matte.

Near-black rectangle on light, or near-white on dark, radius 6-10, 32-40px tall, 14/500, 12-16px side padding, no shadow. Label alone or with a 10px chevron. Hover steps the fill 150ms, about +11 L* on dark and -4 L* on white. The same button sits in nav and hero.

Full pill in the page's strongest neutral: near-black on light, off-white on dark, never pure white on pure black. 40-48px tall, 14-16px at 500, 20-24px side padding, no shadow. Usually the only filled object on screen. Use #e5e5e6 rather than #fff on near-black, stepping to white on hover.

One saturated brand fill on a near-square rectangle, radius 2-6, no shadow or gradient. 40px at 14/400 in nav, 48px at 16/400 in hero, 20-24px padding, small trailing chevron. Use white or dark text by contrast. Nothing else on the page uses this colour, so it reads as the action.

Flat saturated pill, 40-52px tall, 16/500, 24px side padding, no shadow, optional small arrow. Friendly and familiar, so it needs a confident colour. One fill per page, echoed once in a tag or highlight. Darken about 8 L on hover. Dark text on light accents, white on deep ones.

Small pill that repeats on every card: 33px tall, radius 16.5, 15px at weight 425, 16px side padding, 10px trailing chevron, 300ms transition. Low height keeps it product-like rather than marketing-loud, so it can sit under rates and tables. The chevron grows a stem on hover.

Radius 0 to 2, solid ink or a single brand colour, 40-52px tall, 16px sentence-case or 13-14px caps at 500-700, 16-24px padding. No icon, no shadow. Corners match tiles and rows, so it reads as one more piece of the grid. Inverts to white on photography.

Monospace uppercase label on a charcoal or black block, 36-41px tall, radius 0-8, 12-14px at 300-500, tracking 0.05-0.1em, 16-24px padding. Text in light grey rather than white. An ASCII > replaces the arrow. Square corners and mono make the control read as engineering, not marketing.

A short word in a wide box: 280-300px by 52-58px, radius 0 or full, 12-14px caps tracked 0.1-0.2em, centred. Width is fixed and ignores the label, which feels like print. Suits fashion, hospitality, museums and outdoor brands. Avoid on product pages, where it reads as slow.

Dark chip with one inner top highlight: 36px, radius 12, 14/500, 14px padding, fill about #242424, 1px border in the fill's own colour so inset 0 1px 0 white at 16% sits one pixel inside the edge. Trailing 12px chevron. On press the light inverts to black at 8%.

Light keycap on a dark page: 36px, radius 8, fill #e6e6e6, 14/500 dark label, leading 16px icon, 12px padding. Outer 2px ring in black at 50%, 14px white glow at 19%, inset -1px black at 20%. Hover steps to pure white and swaps to inset highlights in 200ms. Only one per view.

Saturated fill lit from inside: 44-48px, radius 8-14, 15/550. A lighter inset glow, inset 0 6px 14px at about 48% of a paler tint, or a 1px lighter top edge, plus a tinted drop shadow 0 2px 6px -1px. No visible gradient banding. Reads as glass or enamel, not as a flat web button.

A physical key: warm saturated face, solid darker lip 3-4px tall under it, no blur, radius 6-16, 44-50px, bold 16-18px dark label. Build the lip as box-shadow 0 4px 0 or inset 0 -3px 0. Press drops the face onto the lip. Secondary repeats it in white with a grey lip.

Solid shelf with no blur: 48-62px, 1.5px dark stroke, 4-8px hard offset in a darker tone, bold 16px label, uppercase with wide tracking. Moves onto its shelf when pressed. Printed and playful. Suits illustrated, health, education and consumer brands. One shadow colour across the page.

Pale brand fill inside a heavy ink stroke: 2px near-black border, radius 2-8, 44-52px, 16/600, 14-24px padding, no shadow. Same object in nav, hero and closing band. Comic and warm without being loud. Keep the fill light and the stroke the darkest thing on the page.

Dark pill wrapped by a detached colour ring: 48px, 16/600, 28px padding, box-shadow 0 0 0 4px in a pale brand tint, tight to the edge. The ring is the only bright colour above the fold and marks every primary action. A bigger version adds two faint concentric rings at 16 and 32px.

Neutral pill with a thin multi-hue stroke: 44-56px, full radius, 1.5-2px gradient border running around the perimeter, dark or white fill, 16-18/600 label. Colours come from the page art. Same treatment in nav, hero and close. Keep saturation in the stroke only, never in the fill.

Label plus a separate arrow shape: a 32-40px disc or tile holding a thin arrow, nested 4px inside the right end, or a twin disc touching the pill. 40-56px tall, 14-20px label. Hover moves only the chip. Two shapes reading as one gives a plain pill its own identity.

A plain control carrying one owned glyph instead of an arrow: a 6-12px solid dot left of the label, a stepped pixel chevron, a tilted product icon. 40-56px, neutral or brand fill. The glyph repeats in lists and links, so one small mark does the work of a logo.

Square block with one cut corner: 36-52px, black fill, 14-15/600, arrow icon, 8px diagonal clip at top right using clip-path, or an edge sliced about 15 degrees. The same cut appears on code blocks and panels, so it reads as a brand mark. One accent instance per group.

The control carries a fact as well as a verb: a price in the label or 16px beside it, a status such as Sold Out, a 15px fulfilment note beneath, a mono second line, or a 64px face. Same shape in every state, 41-64px. Use it where buying or trust is the question.

Pricing columns where only one button is filled: every button full column width at 36-44px and 14-16px, all white with 1px line or a stone tint, except the recommended plan in solid ink. No badge or accent needed, since one dark control steers the choice.

A button that teaches its shortcut: 32-36px, radius 4, 14px label, then an 18-20px inset square keycap holding one letter, 1px lighter outline, 8px after the label. Works only if the shortcut really works. Suits tools people use daily, in nav and hero. Add a lower lip for depth.

Main action plus a separate chevron cell for platform or method: same height, 1px seam in the page colour, chevron cell 28-36px wide, radius only on the outer corners. Clicking the label runs the default. Use when one verb has real alternatives, such as an OS download.

The button sized to the headline, not to the UI: 60-96px tall, label 20-53px, full pill or block, one per screen. It reads as a second headline or a game control. Use for launches, single-product and brand pages. Keep it large on phones. Light weights hold up at this size.

An action fixed to the viewport for the whole scroll: a 34-48px bar centred 24px above the bottom edge, or a corner block 16px in. Same label in every chapter. Inverts by section so it never disappears. Use on long stories and one-goal sites. Hide it near the page's own closing action.

On a dark page, no bright button at all: 36-48px, radius 6-16, fill white at 5-8%, 1px light line at 12-19%, 14-16/500 near-white. Quieter than the headline, so the darkness stays unbroken and the control reads as lit glass. Hover raises fill and border together.

Standing control with a pale edge: transparent or white, 1px at 10-15% ink, radius 6-10, 26-36px tall, 13-14/500 ink label, optional 12px arrow. No shadow. Use for See more, Log in and every action under a section heading. Hover darkens the border or adds a 4% fill.

1px full-ink stroke, radius 0-2, no fill, 40-48px tall, 16px label inset 16px, 14-24px arrow 8px after it, width hugs text. Inverts to 1px white on photography. The same box at every level. Print-like and sure of itself, and the cheapest way to look like a car or furniture brand.

Outline with a serif label: 34-58px, radius 0 or full, 1-1.5px ink, 15-21px serif at 400, sentence case, 9-26px padding, hugging the text. Reads as a wine list or gallery label, not a SaaS control. Border and text inherit the section: white on photo, ink on paper.

Pill outline same height as its primary: 32-48px, 1-2px stroke in ink or accent, transparent or white fill, 16/500 label, 20-30px padding. Equal size to the primary, with weight alone ranking them. Inverts to a white keyline on dark sheets. Fill on hover.

No border, just a faint fill: ink at 4-8% or a warm stone tint, 36-40px, radius matching the primary, 14-16/500 ink label, optional thin arrow. It stays visibly a button without competing. Use a warm tint on warm pages so it does not read as disabled grey. Hover to about 12%.

Control over photo or video: 32-53px, fill black at 30-50% or white at 10-20% with blur, 1px white at 12-60%, white 12-15px label, optional thin arrow. Keep it legible on the brightest frame. Hover raises fill and border together in 300ms. Never rely on the border alone over busy pictures.

Secondary on a dark page: 36-44px, radius matching the primary, vertical gradient from about +12 to +6 levels over the ground, or white at 5%, 1px white at 3-14%, 14/500 near-white. Sits one step above the ground, so it is a real object without taking the eye from the light primary.

White key on a light page: 36-48px, radius matching the primary, no border, 0 0 0 1px at 10-16% ink as a ring, 0 1px 3px or 0 2px 6px -1px soft shadow, slightly darker base. 14-15/500 ink label. Tactile on flat ruled pages. Pairs with a lit or top-lit primary.

Ghost button whose border repeats the page's own colour rail: 36px, radius 6, 2px gradient stroke from one hue at top left to another at bottom right, mid-grey mono caps 14/300. It may be the only colour in the nav. Use only if that gradient already exists elsewhere.

Two solids instead of solid plus outline: one colour means buy, a second means navigate. Same height, radius and padding, 16/500. Use for Compare and View all on pages crowded with outlines. Works with inverse pairs, such as dark fill with accent label against accent fill with dark label.

A row of equal quiet chips rather than one secondary: 32-50px, 1px hairline or faint fill, 8-12px gaps, 14px grey label with a real 14-24px logo or line icon. Good for platforms, community links and filters. Equal weight, left aligned. Real full-colour logos may be the only saturation.

An outline that is not a rectangle: a 1px oval tilted -3 degrees like a pen circle, four corner brackets with no sides, crop marks overshooting by 8px, a bevelled plaque. Keep the label horizontal and plain. Use one such shape sitewide, and only where the brand already draws.

A secondary that opens choices in place: 40-44px outline with a chevron opens a 340px popover, radius 8, caret up, 56px rows of real OS logos and 15px labels. It overlaps the content below and spares a separate downloads page. Close on escape and outside click.

A plain link scaled into the object that closes a page: a pill 64-92px tall spanning the container, 20-22px label centred, 1px white outline or one pale fill. Use at the end of an index, for View all. It works because it is the only large control on the page.

Same size as surrounding text, 1px underline offset 3-4px, in ink or at about 30% ink so the line is quieter than the word. No arrow, no colour. Use thickness and offset set explicitly. Hover shifts the underline to full ink. The default link for prose, lists and portfolios.

Two grades of link: 1px dotted underline offset 3-6px for a term or a quiet alternative, solid 1px for a real destination. Grey or ink text, no colour. Terms without a tooltip stay plain, so the underline carries meaning. Good for pricing bullets, docs and dense product copy.

Accent text with a small chevron, no underline: 14-17px at 400-700, chevron 8-10px, 6-8px gap. On hover the chevron grows a stem into an arrow and moves 2-4px right. Place it at the foot of a card, aligned across the row. Works when accent is the only interactive colour.

Ink label with an arrow glyph and no underline: 14-16/500, 14-16px arrow, 8px gap. Direction carries meaning: right changes page, down scrolls, diagonal leaves the site. Stack beneath offers as the only action. Keep the arrow thin and optically aligned to the x-height centre.

16px label with a 1px underline under the words only, and an arrow sitting past the line, 6-8px away. It can replace every button on a page, including the nav booking action. Reads as considered rather than default. Use a deep brand colour instead of blue.

Label beside a circled arrow: a 24-48px ring or tonal disc holding a 12-16px arrow, 8-16px gap, 14-16px label at 500-700. Ring at 1px grey on light, white at 30% on dark. Hover fills the ring or expands it. Quieter than a pill, louder than a link, and the arrow chip recurs sitewide.

12-14px uppercase mono, tracking up to 0.1em, 1px rule 3-4px under the baseline at exact text width, no arrow or fill. White on photo, ink on paper. Can be the main call to action on fashion and technical sites, sitting at the right end of a heading row.

Link set in the editorial voice: 20-27px serif or italic, 1px rule 3px below or none, a 5px solid triangle or small arrow, the verb varying by content. No button shapes anywhere. Isolation or a sentence end marks it. Suits agencies, culture and galleries with strong type.

A link that owns a full cell: label left, arrow flush right, 1px rule beneath spanning the column, 56-80px tall, in rows of two or three. Replaces a card row for secondary destinations. Use 16-30px labels. Hover shifts the arrow only. Reads like a form field or a timetable.

Label sitting on a solid rectangle exactly the text height, no radius, like a marker stroke or an inverted caption: 12-16px tracked caps on a peach, or black on white. Tight padding of 0 to 6px. Same tint recurs in icon chips. Suits portfolios and culture sites.

A plain word with one owned typographic mark and no underline: red parentheses around 12px caps, a trailing solid dot at 0.55em, a leading plus. The mark appears in nav, footer and sections, so it becomes a tiny signature. Use one mark only and keep it the same everywhere.

A consistent docs exit that closes each section: a grey 13-15px Learn or Features label, then a line of quiet links, as 32px hairline pills or 15px grey words each ending in a small +, closing with More. Same position every time. Turns depth into rhythm.

Text alone: 15-20px, title case or caps, no underline, no arrow, no colour, at the left margin under a statement. Works only with strong hierarchy around it, since nothing signals interactivity. Add a hover underline and a focus ring. Best in portfolios and film sites.

evidence.name: Yves Tumor - Safe In The Hands of Love

spec: Square ghost icon button for toolbars and app chrome: 28-36px square, radius 6-8, 16px icon at 1.5px stroke in muted ink, no border. Hover adds a 6% ink fill and takes icon to full ink in 100-150ms. Needs an accessible name and a tooltip. Keep a 44px hit area on touch.

Prev and next on the heading row: two 32-48px circles or squares, 1-2px stroke, 16-20px thin arrow, 8px gap, disabled side at 40%. Optional '01 / 03' counter or a 72x32 grey progress pill between. Align right to the row. The same arrow can return at 24px inside links.

Control on looping media: a 36-40px circle or pill, translucent dark fill at 48-72%, two white bars or a play disc, optional 2px ring that draws playback progress, 14px label and runtime. Bottom right in tiles. Autoplay stays silent, and the chip offers sound. Every clip gets one.

Survey marks instead of dots: six 8px dark squares at 32px pitch, bottom right of the slide. The active tick stretches to a 30px bar that fills with accent as autoplay progress, over a pale track. Each tick needs a 24px hit area and aria-current.

A persistent helper, shaped as the product rather than a stock bubble: a 44-72px disc, a 126-156px white pill with 1px line, soft shadow and a 26-36px orb, or a brand tile 72x80. Fixed 16-40px from the corner. Keep a ring on dark bands so it never disappears.

A tall thin cue: 32-40px wide by 46-80px high capsule, 1px white or 25% white fill, long thin down arrow that draws in a loop. Unusually tall ratio, so it reads as an instrument, not a badge. Base of the viewport or right edge at mid-height. Stops under reduced motion.

One solid shape on an image as its only control: a 60-64px white disc, or a notched tile with stepped corners, holding a thin 16-20px arrow, no shadow, centred or low left. The photo stays uncropped by any label. Hover scales the icon, not the disc.

A 64px black circle holding a thin chevron, straddling the seam between the last section and the footer, half on each. It marks the end of the content and gives the footer a clear hinge. 200ms transition. Use one per page, for back to top or a next chapter.

Small square chip with a custom icon: 16-48px, radius 3-4, one flat fill or 1px border, paired with a 12px mono label 14px to its right, or fixed in a corner as menu and back. Replaces standard buttons sitewide. Corners match the mark, so it reads as a keycap.

Row of 40px circles at about 80% opacity of a warm dark tone, white 14px glyphs, 8px gaps, 200ms transition. Readable on any frame without competing with film behind it. Six at most. Each link needs an accessible name, since the glyph is the only label.

An OS desktop idiom replacing navigation: 70px flat icons such as a folder and a circled i, bottom right, 11px caps labels 26px below. Single click opens. Only for studios and spatial sites where the interface is the concept. Provide a real nav for keyboards and phones.

Two pills of equal height, 40-50px, 16px at 400-500. Primary filled, secondary transparent with 1px border in ink or white at 25%. 8-16px gap, 20-24px padding. Same pair at about 32px in the nav. Label two words or fewer. On dark or photo the outline turns white.

Rectangular pair, radius 2-8, 36-50px, 16/500, 16-24px padding, 12-16px gap. Primary solid, secondary 1px line, pale on light product pages and full ink on print-like ones. Both may end in the same arrow. No shadow or gradient. Stacks full width on phones with the primary on top.

Primary solid, secondary a pale tint with no border, same height and shape: 36-56px, 14-16/500, 8-12px gap. The tint is about 6% ink, a warm stone, or a lighter step of the primary's own hue. Calmer than an outline, since no second line enters the composition.

One container only: a filled button, then a same-size text link in the same accent or muted ink with a chevron, 16-36px gap, sometimes stacked 16px below. One filled shape per screen, so the eye has a single target. The most restrained pair and the safest default on brand pages.

A dark or lit primary beside a white raised twin, same height and radius: 36-48px, radius 10-14, 14-15/500. Primary carries an inset top highlight, secondary a 1px ring at 10-16% and soft 0 2px 6px -1px shadow. 8-16px gap. Tactile and expensive, and it depends on matching metrics exactly.

On near-black, no colour: light fill plus a charcoal fill one or two steps above the ground, same size, 34-44px, 14-16/500, 8-10px gap. The charcoal is about #1b1b1b or white at 5-10%. A third action can sit far right as plain text with an arrow.

Two buttons of exactly equal width and weight, 48-62px, radius 4-14, 16-20px labels, 10-16px gap. Use when both routes are truly peers, such as two sign-in providers or two audiences. Align the pair to the block above. Add a quiet third line for the fallback.

An arrow shape as the second action: a plain label beside a 40-50px white tile or coral disc holding an arrow, or two rectangles each with a 6px triangle pinned far right. The arrow tile recurs as a sitewide link device, so the pair builds a signature.

For developer tools: a real install command beside the button, same height, 40-48px. 13-14px mono, a $ or terminal glyph, a copy icon, 1px line at 10-15%, 12-16px gap. Clicking copies. The command is a true second action, and can even lead. Must be a command that works.

Second action copies a prompt for a coding agent: a 40-44px outlined chip holding three overlapped 24-28px tool icons, 14-16/500 label, a copy glyph or a divider and chevron. 12-16px gap from a solid primary. A current developer pattern, so use only for tools agents really use.

Both buttons are keys: same shape, a 2-4px solid lower lip, 36-50px, 8-12px gap. Primary saturated with a darker lip, secondary white with a grey lip and muted text. Hard edge instead of blur reads as pressable. Add keycap letters on tools, chunky type on education and consumer sites.

Colours taken from the section, not a palette: 48-52px pills, primary filled with the dark tone of the photo and its label tinted to the headline accent, secondary white at 10% with 1px white at 30%. 12px gap. Buttons change per section and never feel imported.

Square solid beside a ghost framed by printer's marks: 36px, radius 0, 14/500, primary near-black, secondary with 1px hairlines overshooting each corner by about 8px and a tiny plus at lower right. No fill. Fits ruled, blueprint pages where lines already run through the layout.

App stores as the pair: 56-64px badges with matched height and radius 8-16, 16px gap, real glyphs, one in ink and one white with a hairline. Or lead with one store as a labelled tile and shrink the second to a 64px icon tile, so one action leads.

Each route is explained before the click: an 18px caption over its own 48px button in two columns, or three or four 58px intent tiles with solid icons. Use when audiences differ and a label cannot carry the difference. Keep every caption to about four words.

Both labels in mono or tracked caps: 40-59px, radius 0-8, 12-16px, tracking 0.05-0.1em, 8-16px gap. Solid plus 1px outline, identical metrics. Inverts to solid white plus a near-invisible outline on dark panels. Keeps a colourful or playful page technical.

Two controls read as one: 40px pills with only a 4px gap, or adjoining segments sharing a border. Use for two modes of the same action rather than a ranked pair. Keep the nav repeat at about 34px. Fill the active or primary side, outline the other.

Fill moves one step only. Measured medians: dark fills lighten +11 L*, white and pale fills darken 4 L*, saturated fills darken 8 L*. 150ms on ease or cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), or an instant cut. No lift, shadow or scale. The default for almost every button.

Fill or whole control fades to 85-88% opacity in 100-150ms, with no colour change. The cheapest response that works on any ground, including photos and gradients. Faster than a tone step to build, flatter to feel. Use on white-on-dark pills and rows of neutral buttons.

Ink and paper trade places: fill, text and border all swap in one 150-300ms move, with no movement or shadow. Outline fills solid, or solid flips to the page colour. Hard and confident. The usual response for square, printed and editorial buttons.

Fill enters from an edge rather than fading: an absolute inner layer at scaleX(0) goes to scaleX(1) in 300ms on cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), with the label flipping colour on the same curve. Works best on outlined buttons. Keep transform-origin left, and let it leave the way it came.

Only the arrow moves. The chevron grows a stem and travels 4-6px right, or a diagonal arrow moves 5px up and right, over 240-300ms on cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), while the fill darkens slightly. The button stays put, so the click target never shifts.

Two stacked copies of the label: the first rolls out and the second rolls in by translateY(-100%), 200-300ms, clipped by overflow hidden, as the fill deepens. Lively but contained. The duplicate needs aria-hidden. Keep it to one element on a page, or it becomes a tic.

Button moves -4px,-4px while a solid 4px 4px 0 shadow appears, 150-200ms, no blur. On outlined pills, -4px 4px works just as well. A hidden plate can shift instead, revealing a second colour beneath. Printed and playful. Use one shadow colour across the page.

The light changes, not the colour: a radial top glow brightens, or a sheen highlight shifts position, 300ms on cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1). Animate a registered custom property so the gradient interpolates. Rare and subtle. It reads as a lit material.

Depth is removed on hover: the lower lip and outer glow drop away and the fill darkens, instantly or by 100ms. The button seems to sink before you click. Fits any button that has a lip or inset ring. Pair with a further 1px travel on press.

For ghost and glass buttons: border rises by about +.10 alpha and fill by +.04 to +.24, 150-300ms, with border tracking fill so the edge never pops. An inset ring can appear instead, adding no layout shift. Motionless. The right answer for secondaries on dark and on video.

Lift with an overshoot: translateY(-4px) and a shadow growing to 0 30px 50px -10px at 14%, 450ms on cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1). Warm and deliberately theatrical. Use once on a page, on a large single call to action. Never on rows of buttons.

A wide white or tinted glow appears, 0 0 32px at 50%, 200ms. Common on dark developer pages and almost always cheapening, since glow is not a material. Prefer a tone step. Keep it for one button on a page already lit by neon art.

Pale tile, one ground across the row, product centred at about 60% of tile width. Below it one justified line: 12-14px name left, same-size price right, flush with the tile edges. Optional 11-12px muted descriptor. No button, no badge. 16-24px gutters. The whole tile links.

Tile or model shot with no card chrome. Under it, left-aligned or centred: 13-14px name, 13-14px price, then at most one 12-14px muted line. Reserve three lines of description so prices share a baseline. Outline heart appears top-right on hover only. Six across at 210px, four at 340px.

Flat 3:4 tile in #f2f2f2 or one tone off the page, radius 0, no name, price or badge at rest. Cut-outs alternate with tight detail crops. 10-12px gaps, 12px caps label above the rail, partial tiles at both ends. Use only for a campaign rail that leads to real listings.

Name and price stay small, 13px, and colour carries the card: 12-20px round swatches at about 30px pitch, selected one ringed 2px off the dot, hit area 32px. Hover previews that colour in the tile. A 12px capacity or material line closes it. Fairphone goes large: radius 40, 24px name and price.

4:5 model shot on one studio colour, tiles about 308px with 34px gutters. Under it, 44-48px cut-out product thumbnails as swatches with chevrons at the ends, then centred 16/600 name, 16px descriptor, 19/600 price, stars with count, Compare radio. Hover draws a 1px frame and swaps to a detail shot.

Square warm tile, radius 8, 12px mono tag. 17px name, 16px muted descriptor, then two 13px icon spec rows between 1px rules, then 'From $45 / $2.65 per meal' with the unit price muted, then 32px pill. Swap the rows for one segmented meter or a funding bar when one number decides.

The add control lives on the image. A 64x40 pill sits 12px from the tile's bottom right, always visible, or a dark 30-36px button fades in on hover and stays visible on touch. It adds the default variant without leaving the grid, then shows a tick for 1.5s. Below: 15/500 name, muted line, price.

Tile, name, one muted line, price, then an always-visible button: 30-41px, left-aligned or full width, 1px outlined or solid. Use it where the shopper decides on the card, as with books, single-size goods or a short homepage row. Align every button to one baseline by reserving caption lines.

Everything a big retailer must show, in a fixed order on a 4px rhythm: name, descriptor, price largest at 24-28/700 with superscript cents, stars and count, green or red status dots with place names, variant thumbs, Compare. Round 40px cart button beside the title. Sale in one colour only.

Card radius 24-32 tinted one step off a deep or brand-coloured section, about 348x478, 12-16px gaps, row bleeding past the viewport. Outlined SKU pill, 24-28px name, floating product with small contact shadow, 13px price, one 44-51px pill. Tint comes from the product itself.

No tile or box. A cut-out with a soft contact shadow stands directly on the page ground, about 300px tall, four columns. Centred 14px spec and 16px bold name below. One sticker or a slight rotation carries personality. Needs a clean render and a tinted or cream page.

The grid is a table. 1px ink rules at 25% steps, no fills, no radius. Cell: 11px bold caps name, 11px size line, product, 40-52px square colour chips with 10px names, then a full-width 36px row, bordered on top, with ADD TO CART left and price right. Hover inverts the row.

A set shows what is inside. 1px hairline card, large radius, squircle thumbnail, name, 16px copy, price, 56px arrow disc. Below it a nested tinted panel at about half the outer radius lists contents as small mono chips. Simpler form: a rust 'SET SAVINGS' strip above the image and a struck total.

For rooms, classes and tickets. Photo 4:3 or square, radius 8-20, heart top-right, availability or rating chip. Then 14-15px title, muted place or date, and rate with its unit, such as '$995 / night' or '$18 per class'. Classes add three grey stat tiles. Shows take two 51px buttons, details and book.

The artwork is the card. Square or 4:3 art, radius 2-16, then 14-16px title and 13-14px muted author. A 32px chip at the right holds 'Free' or '$49'. Colour goes on outlines only. Shape can code type, as in square releases and round artists. A single series colour unifies different art.

Product info floats on the picture as a tag. Translucent dark or frosted panel about 290px wide, 8px radius, 48-64px square thumbnail, 12px mono name, price, small arrow, anchored to the thing it names. Noom's version sets a 43px serif price on frosted glass over the bottle. Use for shoppable lookbooks.

Horizontal row for tight spaces. 40-56px thumbnail, 12-14px name, price, then one small add control at the right: 28-32px outlined button or round plus. 1px rule between rows. White Cube's table form runs title, artist, year, price, Purchase. Use in cart drawers, cross-sell and editions lists.

Every tile shares one ground and one framing, so the page reads as a single colour field. 4 columns, tile 3:4 or 4:5, gutters 16-34px, no borders. Ground can be white-grey, studio tan or near black on a cream page. Same crop, same angle, product at about 60% of tile width.

Four 3:4 images butted with 1px gaps on 24px page margins, or full bleed with 4px gaps, no card chrome. Model and still-life tiles mix under one studio ground. Captions sit on the page below at 12px, inset 12px. Ends in one small black 'show more'. Reads as a printed contact sheet.
