Columns are drawn, not gapped. 1px solid or dashed rules between cells, no fills, cell padding 20-32px, rules running full bleed to the page edges. Small caps label top-left of each cell, product, then caption low in the cell. Works from 3 to 5 columns at 10-25% ink.

A 3-4 column product grid broken on a fixed beat. Every 8th to 12th cell is a lifestyle photo spanning 1x2 with the row flowing round it, and every 9 to 12 products a full-width band carries a guarantee or story. Page uses numbered pagination with a back-to-top pill. Never interrupt the first row.

Full-bleed lifestyle panels that route by category. 2-4 across, 0-8px gaps, radius 0-10, 420-900px tall. White label bottom-left at 14-24px with one short descriptor, over a bottom scrim only. No arrows or counts. Arc'teryx sets four above the filter bar and underlines the active one.

Grouped product cut-outs stand for a category. Four columns, tile #f8f8f8 or none, 24px gaps, radius 0-8, object at about 65% of tile height with a soft cast shadow. Label under the object, 14-24px, tracked caps or a quiet serif, plus an optional 14px line. No button.

A row of small thumbnails directly under the header routes before any grid. 8 items at about 154px radius 10, or 5 circles at 135px, gap 24, centred 13-16px labels. Crop tight on a texture, face or object. Turns into a swipeable rail with a peek on phones.

One row that bleeds past the page edge. Five and a half tiles at 1-16px gaps, or a 350px text column beside portrait tiles with the third peeking. Heading left, 'Show all' right, arrows only on hover or in the text column, dash pagers at 28x3px on phones. Peek at least 40px.

Few products, each given a tall column to compare. 2-4 columns, 20px gap, about 400x880, tinted fill, newest in a gradient. Product top at 70-80% of column width, 28-34px name, 17-22px one-line descriptor, 'From $' price, one 40-44px button, centred. Apple bleeds white cards radius 28 on #f5f5f7.

No grid at all. Each product gets one viewport on its own ground, black or grey or a colour per line, product centred, a tiny 9-12px mono label bottom-left, two buttons at most. Scroll steps between stages, with a small index to jump. For catalogues under about 12 products.

Objects of different heights stand on one shelf line. 3-5 columns, 24-40px gutters, no tile, items aligned to the bottom of the image cell with a soft book shadow. Centred caption: 12px tag, 12-25px title, price. A count or 'Show All' outline button closes it. Ideal for books and bottles.

A small shop sits next to one big picture. Left half a macro or lifestyle photo, or a pale panel with one book at 50% width. Right half: 'New in' label, 22px title, price, text link, or a 3-column grid of cut-outs. For culture, wine and editorial sites selling a few things.

A catalogue of digital things. Art fills each thumbnail, so the grid needs no tile: 3-4 columns, 16:10 or 4:3, gaps 20px by 74px with meta in the row gap, radius 0-16, faint 1px edge on dark art. 14px title, 13px muted line. Ends in Load More.

Text-first listing for software and plugins. 2 columns of 558x186 cards, gap 24, radius 12, 1px line. 32px icon, 16/600 name, 34px ghost Install at right, 15px description clamped to 2 lines, 13px meta row of avatar, author, count and installs. Sets a directory apart from a shop.

Stores, stays and shows. 3-4 column photo grid at one consistent 4:3 crop, 16px gutters, tabs for city above, 'View all' at the right. Caption triple: title, place, date, with place and date muted. Hover colours only the title. A location page needs an address and hours, not a price.

How a listing opens. Either a compact 28-48px title with a one-line intro and the filter bar in the first viewport, or an image-led band with an 80px light title beside a tall photo. Keep product visible above the fold on a phone. Never open with a full-screen banner.

One row above the grid so the grid keeps full width. Result count first at 15-20px, then 13-16/500 dropdown triggers with small chevrons split by 22px hairlines, Sort pinned right, 1px rule under. Applied filters repeat as removable chips. Sticks on scroll. Best for 3-8 facets.

A tinted tray holds the filters as objects: 54px tall, radius 8, 6px padding, 42px white chips radius 4 with chevrons at 6px gaps. Chips carry tiny previews of their content, such as a colour strip. Far right: count badge and Reset. For browsing galleries with many facets.

Pills switch category, each a real page. 24-30px tall, 999px or small radius, 12-13px, 1px outline, active filled ink. Centred under a 28px title or left under a large one, Sort on the same row at right. Scrolls sideways on phones with the row bleeding off the edge.

Two jobs, two controls. Category pills on top, then one row between rules: 'Filter by +' left, product count centred, 'Sort by' right. Filter opens a drawer, so the grid keeps four columns. Our Place leads with an outlined FILTER button at 32px beside 30px pills. Ulta keeps the launcher sticky.

40px pill row, 1px line, 15px semibold, active filled, right edge fades into a round arrow. On scroll the row moves up and docks inside the 64px header between logo and account, so it never takes a second sticky line. For feeds and content catalogues.

Left rail 180-240px, no card. Rows 48px between 1px rules, 14px/600 labels, chevron right, most facets collapsed. Open lists use 18px checkboxes, 14px labels and muted result counts at right. Two-state facets show count and checkbox inline. Best past 8 facets or for spec-driven buying.

Wide 300-400px facet panel for huge catalogues. 12px grey group labels, wrapped chips 6-8px radius with small tinted icons and 13-14px text, '+N' overflow chip, dual-handle slider with tick labels. Shows the taxonomy at a glance and each click filters at once.

Pill chips with a 24-28px product thumbnail, 48px tall, radius 64, 14px text, on a pale fill, in one sideways-scrolling row above the title or grid. Names the types in shopper language, so a first visitor can pick without knowing the facets.

Filtering set as plain text. One centred 32px serif sentence of comma-separated categories, or ALL and STYLE at 13px on a rule one tile wide, or 12px header links with the active one underlined. For editorial sites and small catalogues under 30 items. Never for large ranges.

The full taxonomy on show in place of a sidebar. Up to ten columns across 1200px, 14px head over four 14/26 muted links. Directories can add a 30px search, a 13-wide A-Z strip of 20px squares and stacked selects. Good when people arrive knowing the name.

One row across the grid width. Left, a capsule of 3 text tabs with the active one a lit pill. Right, a 42px segment of platform glyphs beside a 320px search with its shortcut hint. For app stores and extension directories, where type and platform are the only decisions.

Default product page. Image 55-58% of width, sticky, tile fill or photo. Buy box about 480px: 30px title, stars with linked count, 24px price, instalment line, option groups, 50px full-width add button, delivery line, three-part trust row. Thumbs 48-64px beside or below the image.

Info column first, 400px, sticky at left. 32/500 title, rating, tag, 34px joined size chips, purchase radios between ink rules, 40px add button holding the price, short copy. Two tall images 460x570 fill the rest, 15px apart, with 50px thumbs below. Feels like a magazine spread.

For considered purchases. Left a sticky 870x560 stage, radius 20, one tone off the page. Right a 330px column of steps, each a 28px heading with dark lead and muted continuation, over option tiles radius 12. Later steps stay dimmed until the earlier ones are chosen. Dot progress on the right edge.

One-time versus subscribe as two rows. Each 48-52px, bordered or between rules, radio left, price right, saving in a small tag. The chosen row expands to show cadence and 3-4 benefit lines, ending with skip or cancel any time. The add button total follows the choice.

When options differ in price or format, use tiles, not a dropdown. 2-4 tiles 170x108, radius 8, tiny caps merit label such as Most Popular, option name below, selected tile takes a 2px accent border and pale fill. Books use a table of formats with prices beside one buy button.

The contents are the pitch. Square photo left, 656px info right: 40px title, stars, 24/700 price, bold lead, 16px copy, rule, tracked 'SET INCLUDES' label, then 70px bordered thumbnails at 76px pitch with name and one line each. Closes with a 56px full-width button holding the price.

One object as a theatre set. Product centred or diagonal at 430-700px on a ground that changes with each colourway. Neighbours sit either side as low-alpha outlines with only the dial or blade coloured. Selected colour named beside small dots. PREVIOUS and NEXT at the edges in 12px mono. One clear action.

No price, no cart. Per piece: 14px description, then a 'Dimensions' label indented about 60px with figures beneath. Set in an index column beside a tall photograph, one enquiry link at the end. Fits antiques, furniture, architecture and made-to-order, where the conversation is the sale.

Buy without a product page. Single-product sites and home pages carry the box in place: rounded 20px media beside a 52px headline, price, delivery chips and one pill. Quick view does the same in a right panel with accordion details. Must still show variants and shipping.

Appears once the main button scrolls off. Desktop: 760x90 white bar centred 16px from the bottom, 1px line, soft shadow, 64px thumb, 24px name, 13px sub, 200x53 button with price. Phone: full-width, 44px thumb, name, button. Hidden while the real button is on screen.

Long detail folded under the buy box. Plus-minus rows 44-52px between 1px rules, 13-14px labels: Details, Care, Dimensions, Shipping, Returns. First row open. Rule colour ink at full strength reads premium, at 10% reads quiet. Shipping and returns must be one tap away.

Answers fear at the button. Directly under add to cart: stock dot with ship date, free shipping threshold, returns window, then a three-part icon row. Harney adds a verified quote in a 490px rounded card beside the title. Keep to four facts, each one specific.

After the buy box and in the drawer. Four cards in a row with a heading such as 'Goes with', arrows top-right, radius matching the page, or compact 56px thumb rows with a small outlined add button so a shopper can add without leaving. Show real pairs, never the item itself.

Right drawer 420-480px, full width on phones, over a 40% scrim. Fixed header with count, shipping progress line, scrolling lines with 88px thumb, name, variant, 32px stepper, line price, Remove. Fixed footer: subtotal, 'tax and shipping at checkout', delivery date, 52px Checkout. Updates in place.

Full cart page: lines at 120px thumbs on the left between 1px rules, sticky 380px summary on the right with subtotal, shipping, tax, total at 18/500, collapsed promo field, 52px Checkout, delivery date and returns line. On phones the summary follows the lines and Checkout pins to the bottom.

An empty drawer that routes. About 422px on warm off-white: 48px header, 24/36 two-line message, 11px caps label, then five 374x66 outlined rows radius 4 with a 48px cut-out and 14px label at 16px gaps, then a pinned 48px outlined 'Shop all'. Allbirds stacks black pills instead.

An empty drawer with a personality. About 435px, 60% grey scrim, 40px header holding BAG (0), free shipping line with a thin progress rule, a tinted body, 20px two-line message in the brand's voice, one large pale brand mark, 'Shop all' pinned at the base. Use only when the voice is real.

Free shipping progress as the drawer's headline: 12-13px line over a thin rounded bar. Empty state centres one display headline, one line and a 48px pill. A pinned bottom rail holds 304x98 upsell cards with thumb, name, price and a 32px round plus, with arrows, so adding never leaves the drawer.

Wide 600px drawer used as a small shop. 'Your Cart (0)' at 20px serif, ink rule, plain continue-shopping and sign-in links, then 'Recommended For You' with two horizontal cards: 100px grey thumb, 11-12/700 caps name, colour line, price, and a 41px full-width dark ADD TO BAG.

Empty cart as a real page. 40/600 headline, one line offering sign-in, two 360x56 buttons, a hairline help strip, then a 980px promo tile with product art. Parachute keeps it shorter: a sign-in nudge, then newsletter and footer. Never a dead page with an illustration and nothing to do.

For configured or financed goods. Sticky 74px strip: product name left, right-aligned two-line 17px price with footnote marks, updating as options change. A 50px strip under it splits delivery, shipping and pickup with hairlines. The answer to 'what am I at now' never leaves the screen.

A one-step checkout for giving. 390px white panel on a photo. Two-segment frequency toggle, then 116x52 amount chips in 3 columns with 'Other amount' spanning two, selected chip in the accent, one line stating what that amount does, then one 48px full-width button.

Centred stack: 30px outlined pill link, 56-64px two-line headline, 18-20px grey sub under 600px wide, 36-40px button pair. 50-100px gap, then a 1080-1120px real app window starting 470-580px down, cut by the fold, filled with real rows, one small panel breaking its edge.

All left on one 60-96px gutter: two-line 44-64px headline from y 200-275, 16-17px grey sub with a small link right-aligned on its baseline, then a 1250-1320px app window from y~500, cut by the fold, nearly monochrome, fading into the page at its base. No background effect.

Copy stack, then an app window sitting on a 1200-1340px image mat: wallpaper, lifestyle photo or dithered gradient, radius 12-28px, 40-64px of mat around the window, cropped by the fold. The mat supplies colour and scale so the interface can stay quiet.

Centred stack, then a 576-1280px video tile with radius 20-32, a real poster frame and a visible play control, starting ~530px down and cut by the fold. The poster is the brightest object on screen. Optional quote card beside it at 24px gap.

Centred stack on a dark or quiet field, then one 330-380px phone rising from the fold with only its top 170-320px visible, lit from behind by a wide flat horizon glow anchored below the viewport. Dim the phone screen so the headline stays brightest.

Centred stack over a schematic of how the product works: one 75px dark logo tile, 1px elbow connectors to 6-8 small mono caps tags naming real systems, lines fading out by 90% of page width. Faint measured grid behind. No screenshot needed.

Centred copy over the product's real unit instead of an app window: a fan of 170x220 lesson cards stepping up left to right, or a 400px sign-in card over two ~2 degree tilted ghosts, or two 24px-radius entry cards. Each holds one true example. Fade the base into the page.

Centred stack led by one 86-154px live brand object above the headline: a dot matrix meter in a bordered tile, an app icon, an outlined mark. It animates or carries detail, with a fainter field fading outward. Headline, 18-20px sub, button pair, then product peeking at the fold.

Two-line 72-80px centred headline with small real objects set inside the line at x-height: a photo chip, a clock, a calendar slot, a selection box round one word. Objects are 56-64px tall, radius 12-16, and carry product truth. One or two per headline, no more.

Centred headline and CTA over a four-row customer logo wall at ~40% white, with 3-4 product panels for one named customer rising over it from the fold: stat glass, phone map, job list, and a before-and-after metric strip. Proof and product become one object.

Black or solid tile ~690px tall under the nav. Tight centred stack from 60px down: 56px product name, 28px subtitle, 19px grey date, button pair. Product sits at the tile's base, cropped by it, with its own screen as the only light source.

Centred copy in a protected empty middle, surrounded by a scene that bleeds off the edges: thin-line room drawing on a floor band, cropped planets threaded by orbit lines, or mirrored diagonals of 44px tool tiles fading outward. Product breaks the fold at the base.

Centred stack with availability pill and 44px CTA, then a strip of ~460x290px real work tiles, 16px radius, running off both edges and cut by the fold. For studios and template sellers whose work is the product. Tiles must be real, varied and specific.

Left 450-520px: small chip, 56px headline over 3 lines, 18/28 grey body, CTA plus text link. Right: real UI at 13px, 700x500, overlapping a colour band, breaking the container to 16px from the viewport edge. Two stacked cards offset 40px add depth. Colour stays behind, never around.

Left copy at 60-120px gutter, 48-64px headline, optional search or CTA. Right half: a cut-out person or tall photo bleeding off top, right and bottom with no frame, no card. Copy never overlaps the subject. Often one thin arc or line ties image to headline colour.

Two exact 50 percent panels, no gap, no radius, full height under a thin nav. One flat colour sampled from the image in the other. Stack centred in the colour half: small label, 56-72px title, one line, 34px solid block button in the panel's own dark.

Left copy, right a crafted system picture: isometric stack of real parts, hairline ray burst around a 178px icon, grainy stepped blocks, or line art at ~400px tall, bleeding off an edge. Flat ground, no photo. A three-column version puts the object dead centre with copy either side.

No effects. 330-500px copy column beside a 380-576px tall or 676x380 photo, radius 0-3, top-aligned to the headline, deliberately uneven margins. Text 32-50px, 17px body, one link. Reads like a catalogue page. For brands whose objects and restraint do the selling.

Copy column ~730px, right a narrow useful rail instead of art: five dated news rows, a what's-new list, a 400x350 latest-item card, four role links or a setup checklist. 12px mono dates, hairline rows at ~120px pitch. The hero starts working immediately.

Left copy, right phone or tablet at real scale tilted 10-20 degrees with a second object behind tilted the other way, long soft shadow, real balances or screens, bleeding off an edge. Keep to consumer finance and bold colour fields. Never more than two objects.

Copy left, one physical product right, on a calm ground that matches its packaging: raking light across a coloured surface, a flat brand field, or soft floor shadow. Product at 400-600px, overlapping nothing. Tracked caps trust row or ratings at the fold.

Left rail vertically centred: eyebrow, 48-58px headline, pill pair. Right 576-1024px video panel, radius 20-42, real footage, 32px mute and pause controls bottom right. Optional soft floor glow. Panel may bleed off the right. Poster frame must look finished.

Left copy 515-560px; right a real artefact instead of an image: live code with annotations, or a bordered benchmark panel aligned to the headline top with tabs, four labelled bars, exact seconds and a reproducible method note. Between 1px rails. Measured proof is the hero object.

Headline left, sub or CTA right, on one 1080-1316px measure, right block bottom-aligned to the headline's last line. A product panel or bento begins directly under it, 28-64px down, so proof enters the first screen and the head takes only ~300px.

A 1240px frame of 1px lines, radius 16, no fills. Left 620-720px cell holds headline, sub, command or CTA at 40px padding. Right cell holds a diagram, or a statement over a 3x2 grid of 208x175 logo cells. Lines only, so structure reads as engineering.

Left 328-640px copy with pill, 64-72px headline, CTA pair and command box. Right an editor or console starting ~x750 and running off the viewport, 1px border, radius 8-16, optional second window overlapping. The cut says there is more.

Left column: 56/68 headline, body, pill CTA plus text link. Right: staggered three-column mosaic of tall customer cards, 8px radius, each a different real image with logo and link, columns offset 60-100px and bleeding off the right and bottom edges.

Copy on top, then a textured or gradient plate ~70-100% of the container holding a floating app card at real density, beside a 308px rail with a 30px two-tone statement and a plain feature list. Plate crosses the fold. The texture is the only decoration.

Image fills the viewport under an overlaid nav. Lockup anchored bottom-left at 40-96px inset: tag, 56-80px white headline, 16-18px sub, 46-50px pill. Three proof columns or a second action on the same bottom baseline at right. Local veil on the lowest 45% only. Top half stays clean.

Media panel inset 8-32px from the viewport, radius 16-32, height to the fold, nav inside it or on page colour above it. Page colour shows as a frame. Copy at 56-120px inside, 48-72px headline. A 56px round arrow may straddle the base. Modern default for photo-led product brands.

Image full viewport, one title at 15-20vw, line-height 0.8, tracking -0.05em, touching or crossing the margins, bottom-anchored, two lines offset left and right. No veil. Only a tiny 12px nav and one 32px outlined action hung above the second line. For culture, fashion, model launches.

Full-bleed or 700-800px image with copy at left and one real functional card docked bottom-right: 318x190 frosted agent line, 416x128 offer with price, donation widget, 285x165 live stat, or two 474x260 product cards. Card radius 8-20. It proves the claim inside the picture.

Subject and interface share depth: figure rising through a 400px 3px translucent phone outline with a live balance on her chest, or a 360px word behind the roof and in front of sky using a cut-out layer. Needs a clean cut-out and a deliberate overlap.

Image has a composed end instead of a rectangle: fades into page colour at the fold so the portrait has no base, or clips to a 120px bottom radius on a brand field, or a cut-out building sits on paper. Lockup bottom-left, actions bottom-right on one baseline.

Two full-height panels edge to edge at exactly 720px each, or a 480px central photo column with text in the side thirds. Zero gutter. One word or wordmark sits exactly on the seam. Panels can act as a chooser, one link per panel. No headline needed.

Edge-to-edge image ~810px tall. Bottom-left: caps title and short dek in 32px white serif. Bottom-right: a two-column index of 15px rows, active row full white, others ~40% opacity, with a small ring timer. The hero doubles as a table of contents.

Full-bleed image with subject in the right 55%. Copy column left, vertically centred, at 56-140px gutter: 48-64px white headline, 16-18px sub, pill or text link. Shot so the left is naturally dark. Leave the subject unveiled. Also works mirrored with subject left.

Mid-tone image with no central subject, flat 20-35% black overlay or none. Centred 40-85px headline, one 12-17px line, small link. Give it edges: the name spread into the four corners at ~90px, small side labels, or two 12px captions flanking the title. For hospitality, food, interiors.

Solid brand colour covers the left 40% of a video or photo and fades to clear by 55%, or the image fades left into grainy near-black. Copy sits on the solid part with full contrast. More honest than a scrim, and it carries identity. Grain stops banding.

Viewport-filling image with no headline. Text no larger than 30px: a caption bottom-left or a centred title, small nav, nothing else. Only for images strong enough to be the message: portfolios, fashion, architecture. Add a thin scroll cue so it does not look unfinished.

Image held back from the edges by a wide paper margin: 960px plate with caption row below, 75% viewport inset plate, or a 1400px photo starting ~500px down under a ghost wordmark. Copy lives on paper, never on the image, so no scrim is ever needed.

Full-width crafted non-photo image in place of a picture: dithered bitmap landscape, stipple grain dunes, one giant flat-faceted brand ribbon ~1300px wide, or the product blurred huge at 30 degrees. Copy left or centred in its calm zone. Single rule-framed plate 700px tall works well.

Retail slide 550-700px tall with product photo, 48-70px headline, 32-48px button, pill pagination and a thin progress bar, sometimes a 150px next-slide thumbnail. For seasonal merchandising only. First slide must work alone, because most visitors never see the second.

Full-bleed muted film, graded cool or desaturated, 48-56px side margin. Caption block bottom-left: 28-64px heading, max ~440-520px wide, 16-17px body. Single action bottom-right on the same baseline. Bottom-only veil. Pause control required. Poster frame first.

Headline on white, then one row: 3 small icon claims left, 238x54 pill right. Below, a 1200-1280px film card, radius 16, starting ~470px down and cut by the fold, with one pause control. The film lives in a card, so type never fights it and legibility is free.

Product on seamless studio ground or macro, no container: car filling the right 60% on grey, hands setting a dial, an object assembling. Copy sits in empty ground with no overlay. Small pause control. The film cuts between wide and macro, so the product becomes the graphic shape.

Dimmed film with ~30% flat scrim or a slight vignette. Centred 48-96px serif or caps headline, one 14-24px line, small button. Warm lived-in footage rather than empty rooms. Cuts every 3-5 seconds, all shots graded alike so the lockup holds over each.

Fast reel with one fixed brand element: 120px WATCH disc dead centre, giant wordmark at 80% width, or a large letterform mask ~330x580 the footage plays through. Clips cut every ~1 second. For studios and brands whose work is varied and the mark must hold it together.

Film inset 16-24px with paper or white gutters, radius 0-16, under the nav, 1392-1408px wide. One small tracked caption centred, or a 50-100px title bottom-left at ~58px in. The gutter gives the film the feel of a framed print and calms hard cuts.

Abstract footage as atmosphere: horizontal motion blur, liquid metal on black, one inflated material. Dark at the left for type, ~70% of frame near black. 620-900px tall, ending in a hard edge. Left-aligned 72-80px headline, 18px sub. Cheap to loop and always legible.

Film plus changing words: a 24px subtitle line at bottom-left that changes per scene, or a 21px italic pull quote inside a 1px hairline frame, or sentences aligned to window slats. The copy has to be worth reading. Include an audio toggle if there is sound.

Headline as a sentence-long paragraph: 48px weight 300 at 1.15-1.2 leading, 4 lines, first sentence ink, the rest ~60% ink, crossing a ribbon so type takes its hue. 14px live counter above, 44-48px CTA pair below, logo row between hairlines at the fold.

One large flat or soft shape behind centred type, and the type overprints it: 660px stepped brand glyph, 1050px white disc in a blurred colour field, or a floor glow. Headline 100-140px, line-height 0.85-1.05, button pair. No knockout, no shadow. The shape is the only decoration.

One sentence, 48-92px, on paper colour, with a single hand-drawn stroke on one or two words: wobbly underline, ring, 3px accent. Stroke is an SVG path, not a CSS underline. ~160px of clear space above and below. Real tiles or line art rise at the fold.

Headline at one third height, then deliberate emptiness, then a real image or card entering at y 720-840, cut by the fold. Copy sits off-axis or centred at 56-88px. Top two thirds nearly bare, bottom edge rich. Scrolling is the reward. Faint grid may fade between them.

Plain centred stack: optional 11-14px label, two-line 72-128px headline, 13-20px sub, CTA. Works only with a distinctive voice, tight 1.0 leading, balanced lines and ~120px top air. Something must rise at the fold: a line drawing, a ribbon, a card edge.

Left or centred 56-96px headline, 20-24px sub, 46-56px CTA, then a row of proof instead of a picture: four 36px numerals with 12px labels, six overlapped avatars, a star rating, or a two-cell 96px news strip straddling the next section.

Name or claim at 150-450px, weight 500-900, leading 0.74-0.95, tracking to -0.055em, measured and fitted to the full width after fonts load, on a flat field, bottom-anchored. Tiny 11-14px text elsewhere, one real still. Festivals, studios, culture, strong local brands. Never for a product that needs explaining.

Centred mark, 34-40px gap, then one 30-44px sentence, optically above true centre, tiny nav, sometimes a second tiny link row at the base. Nothing else. Requires a real mark and a company already known. For anyone unknown this reads as an unfinished page.

Type inside one contained field: 1160x464 dark panel with a living glyph canvas, 496px aurora band between nav and logos, or a full-viewport flat colour poster with wordmark top and statement bottom-left. The field gives type-only heroes mass without a picture.

No media or eyebrow. Two-line headline left at the gutter, ~120px below the nav, ~70px above the real content: plan grid, case-study meta row, article. The page starts doing its job inside the first screen. For pricing, about and docs pages.

Type used as structure: two 140px caps lines justified between 1px rules with a mark in the gap, words stacked into a stepped pyramid, or a small letter beside a 318px word. Small intro, thumbnail and link below on a strict grid.

No headline size at all. A 19px paragraph or lettered list starting at y~270 under a 40px avatar and 14px name, or 12-16px text top-left at a 10-18px inset. Confidence by refusal. Portfolios, labs and archives only. Line length and tone carry everything.

Two-line 64px claim centred at the optical middle, 36px pill pair 24px below, ~290px empty above, and one row of real customer logos pinned to the fold's bottom edge. Only with logos people recognise. Fake or unknown names collapse it.

Headline ~56px over a tight mosaic of real destinations: two 678x199 photo tiles, then four 337x100 rows, radius 24, gaps 4-8px. Every tile is a link with a two-tone label, product image at right and a chevron. The hero is the navigation. Suits stores and multi-product health.

Centred copy in a protected column. Around it ~10 slightly tilted labels, avatars and chips joined by 1.5px wires with ~20px rounded corners, grey shifting to accent along the path, 6px dots at junctions. Wires never cross text. Draws a real workflow, start to finish.

Two centred rows of ~124px dark tiles, radius 28, 1px ~8% border, each holding one real logo or icon. Centre tiles sharp, outer tiles blurred 2-3px at 12-30% opacity, so rows have no last item. 80px title ~50px below, search field under it.

Centred 220x460 phone over four crops tucked behind each other: inner 288px tall, outer 220px, radius ~28, soft ambient shadow. Height steps give depth with no rotation. Each crop shows a different real outcome. Short centred copy above.

Centred headline with ~12-30 small tiles scattered or orbiting around it: 104-140px photos and task squares, radius 8, each with a 13px caption, shrinking and fading toward the edges. Tiles must never touch the copy column. Motion is slow drift on scroll.

~10 unrotated portrait prints 150x205, no borders, scattered with wide gaps round a centred 30px wordmark, bottom row bleeding off, rising at different scroll rates. Or 3-4 crops ~325px wide staggered with two caps phrases. Photos are the only colour. Spacing must feel placed.

Giant 200px word split in two lines left and right, with 3-4 overlapping 400-530px prints stacked at centre covering the middle letters. The eye completes the word. Black on white, archival images, a small caption and date row at the base.

Centred copy above a 1px grid of ~55px cells on a brand field. A cut-out portrait breaks the grid's top edge, with diagonal bars, a row of circles and one tilted real label overlapping its base. Hard edges, no shadow. Bold but disciplined.

Headline above a rail of 4-6 photos, 384-416px wide, 8-16px gaps, touching or crossing both viewport edges. Square or tall portrait, radius 0-16, one finish across all. The rail drifts sideways. Works for local businesses with good photos.

Brand mascot or characters as the central scene: inked character between product tiles casting light that links them, or a tilted monitor with 3D props and blurred foreground. Requires real commissioned art. Never substitute generated clip art or emoji.

One 576x720 image centred on off-white, ~90px from the top, name above, two-line caption below, six 3px progress dots. Reads as a gallery wall with one thing on it. For portfolios and curated sites whose next image is the interaction.

3-5 cards or product cutouts rotated -8 to +25 degrees around a central object, 150-300px, translucent or flavour-coloured, base fading into the page. Bold consumer only. Keep rotations varied and few, or it turns into a sticker sheet.

Three overlapping ~390x185 organic blob-masked photos, stacked with ~10px gaps, yellow pill labels and dashed hand-drawn arrows linking them. Friendly, for family education. Dated anywhere else; do not use for professional products.

Render ground equals page colour exactly, so there is no frame, only soft contact shadows. Object 60-80% of viewport width, headline above and CTA below on the centre axis. Or figures dissolve into the page through a mask, with a 44px name left and price plus pill right at chest height.

One object at ~460-640px, built from thin plates with a colour gradient across each face, with three 11px mono caps callouts on 1px leaders ending in small square nodes, like a technical plate. Keep it inside its canvas. White or pale wash. No shadow plane.

Panel inset 16-24px, radius 24, ~800px tall: black with one product repeated diagonally through fine contour lines, centred white headline overlapping it, or a 1408px render card cut by the fold under a headline with two small fact columns.

Copy left at x~170, object right at 420-640px, nearly dissolving into the ground: matte black render on black with two lit faces, glowing ribbon of real layouts, or iridescent hardware on grey. One light, one material. No product UI needed above the fold.

Pure black, device rising from bottom centre ~510px wide, back-lit, floor glow in the lower corners falling to black, one saturated element as the only colour. No headline, or a 90px line above. Lighting is the entire design. Needs a genuinely good render.

Edge-to-edge render on a pale ground where the logo is a working object: a factory block on a diagonal belt, messy parts entering, neat boxes leaving, belt bleeding off both sides. Headline in the open top-left. Explains the product as a physical joke.

Object sits between layers of type: ~275x520 can with one word passing behind and one in front, 800px server over a 260px ghost marquee, chrome figure overlapping bio text. Requires real depth ordering. Expressive and brand launches.

A code-drawn figure instead of an asset: ring of 1px triangles with moire, ASCII-shaded head in 6-8px glyphs, point-cloud city, extruded tile logo. No images, few words. Portfolios and technical brands. Must respect reduced motion and render a good still.

Full-viewport WebGL room or scene under the nav, no headline above the fold, things to hover and enter. Slow to load and hard to read, so only for studios and games where exploration is the point. Provide a poster and a skip route.

~450x62 field, radius 8, surface fill, 1px border, 18px placeholder, with a ~176x52 accent button inset 4px inside it. Or a 528x73 capsule, 30% white over imagery, with a nested black pill. ~24-40px under the sub. No secondary action. Real product panel below it.

Centred stack, then a 640-700px composer, 116-172px tall, radius 12-16, real caret in placeholder, footer row with attach, mode select and send. 3-4 icon suggestion pills beneath. The input is the demo. Dark interface peeks at the fold.

Command replaces the button: 55-64px pill or 510x64 field split by hairlines into package-manager select, 13-14px mono command and copy icon. Text link beneath. Terminal or product rises at the fold, with any glow hugging the window on three sides. Developer tools only.

Task bar: ~848x64 white pill or 3 selects, zones split by 1px dividers, 12px bold label over 14px grey value, 48px circle or 90x42 search button. Centred under the nav or on a photo. Booking is the only action. Hospitality, travel, local finders.

Search or a single question is the hero, for sites people come to find something in: 85px band with 24px placeholder, 42-56px pill search with filter chips, two cards with search and date, or a lone 1px underline prompt. No marketing claim.

Under the subhead: two 265x68 SSO pills with brand logo and 16px label, 8px gap, hairline 'or' divider, 50px email field with focus border, 134x50 continue pill, 13px legal line. Signup starts on the homepage. For products with self-serve signup.

White ~320px card on a full-bleed photo: Once or Monthly toggle, four amount chips, 40px button stating the exact outcome. Radius 4-8. Donation or quote begins without a page change. For nonprofits and simple priced services.

Split head: headline left, sub and CTAs right spanning its height. Directly below, a four-tab strip fused to a surface frame that runs past the fold; the active tab shares the frame's fill and gains a 2px accent edge. Tabs swap real panels, auto-advance optional.

Headline left, sub and CTAs on one row, then a 1200-1376px canvas, 356-420px tall or cut by the fold, holding live nodes joined by 1px lines, a dark deploy terminal or a builder at work, over a grainy image ground. The picture is the running product.

Beside or under the CTAs, one small working control: 488x176 tabbed copy-prompt card with a mono prompt, or a 522x50 scenario select joined to Start call with a one-line permissions note. The hero does the thing, in one click, with no signup.

Real components or records instead of a screenshot: two columns of live UI cards bleeding off right and bottom, radius 12, or a 1248x620 dark panel with real filters and rows skewed in perspective, breaking the panel top by ~30px.

Visitor advances the story: 704x468 shuffled card deck with two peeking behind, ~640px before-and-after slider with 4 stat chips, or a phone with pill tabs stepping through four product stages. Page holds still while the content changes.

One strange working instrument fills the hero: a date-scrubbed isometric treemap in 1px lines, an ASCII mascot in a real terminal window, a ring HUD around a live animation. For technical brands with a point of view. Must still work as a still frame.

Two 1px full-height vertical rules frame one wide column (x=88/1352 on 1440, or 32/1408). Line sits 14-23 levels off a light ground, 7-11 off dark. Text insets 16-24px. Horizontal rules bleed to the viewport at section changes. Rails pass through tinted and dark bands at lower contrast.

1200px frame with 1px side rails. Sections split into 2-up or 3-up cells sharing hairlines: no gaps, no floating cards, no radius. Cell padding 48px, cell height 0.7-1.0 of its width. Art sits unboxed and is cropped by the cell's rule. 64px empty spacer rows between groups.

Four 270px columns in a 1080px frame: five vertical 1px lines at x=180/450/720/990/1260, outer two solid, inner three dashed, about 6% ink. Lines run the full page behind content and through dark bands. Text starts 16px inside a line; cards snap to the outer lines.

Uneven full-height 1px rules at x like 48/160/1280/1392 or 64/326/1114/1288, 5-8% ink, with tiny diamonds, rings or 2x8px ticks where lines meet or start. Outer margins may carry a faint 8px graph texture. Content fits the column the lines define.

No side margin: 1px rules run viewport edge to edge, the page splits at 720 then 360, and each cell holds one thing. Radius 0, no shadows. Images span 2x2 cells with 29px inset or bleed to the rules. Rules take the section's ink colour and stop with it.

Four 300px columns with 32px gutters in 1296px, a 1px ink vertical rule centred in each gutter, lead story spanning two, 1px horizontal rules between stories, no cards. Or three 420px columns each opened by a small label over a 1px rule.

No centred max-width: 16-32px side gutters at 1440, 24 commonest, content about 1392px wide. Four-up at 354 pitch and two-up at 712 snap to the same edges as logo and footer, so the left edge is one unbroken line. Item gutters 12-24px.

Strict columns inside wide margins: three 376px columns with 32px gaps at x=124/532/940, or six 176px columns with 32px gaps from x=112. Nav, sections, carousels and footer all start on these lines, so unlike subjects still align down the page.

Full-width hero, then 2-up tiles about 702x580 with 12px white seams and 12px page margins, radius 0, no shadow. Tiles alternate pale grey and black in a checker so neighbouring images never compete. Copy centred at each tile's top.

1060px container: 360px label column, 700px content column from x=550. One short 20px/500 label per section, blank below it. Headline, media, index and form share the content's left edge; nothing spans across. 1px rule between sections, 60px padding each side.

Left rail 296-320px holds title, one line and action, top-aligned and often sticky 100px from top. Right column takes the rest (688-1024px) with any content type. Same split in every section, 1px rule between, about 58px padding above and below.

1280px rail, two columns, 64px gap: 48/48 heading at x=80, 24/32 lede at x=752 in 70% ink, text link 30px under, media 80px below and outdented 24px. 128px section padding, full-bleed hairline between sections. Same recipe every section.

Page divides exactly at x=720: paired 720px panels butt with zero gutter, and captions, footer columns and newsletter land on 720, then 360 sub-lines at 370 and 1090. Panels are image or flat colour, never cards. Optional 1px centre rule on a 16px inset sheet.

Media and cards start at x=32, all text starts at x=64, in every section. Card copy, headings and statements share the 64 line, drawing one invisible reading line down the page while images fill to the 32 margin. Three-up tiles, 24px gaps.

Section headings hang 140px left of the body: 64-80px heading at x=158, all body at x=298 running about 985px wide. Repeat unchanged down the page with 250px plain gaps. The outdent is the only grid gesture, so keep everything else quiet.

A 2px ink rule across 32px gutters opens each section. 52/52 title top left, 20/24 body pinned to the column's bottom, 681px media at right from x=727, 35px below the rule. Title and body sit far apart on purpose, joined by the rule.

Equal images centred on x=720. Captions right-aligned 33px left of each image; the right 500px stays blank for the whole page. Asymmetry comes only from captions, which sit against the image edge like labels on a drawing.

Uneven columns hanging from one top line: x=10/804/963/1201 on 1440, 190px gap after the bio, 160-240px between lists, 10-16px page margin. Or 300/580/remainder zones. Reads as an index, so no images or cards compete.

Let the viewport or logo set the grid. 900px divides 16/56/16/724/16/56/16 for nav, media and caption; or four 360x900 full-height ground columns, no gaps; or all text flush to the logo's width. Height locks to the viewport.

Mixed tiles on a loose grid: about 640, 305 and double-height tiles on 36px gutters with no row alignment, empty cells filled with a dot screen. Or four equal columns on 2px gutters, heights following the artwork. Reads pasted-up, for archives and brand feeds.

The page is a visible table on pale grey: 1px mid-grey lines, 40px number column, 320px name column, then 80px cells, 19px rows, no margins, cards or sections; spacer rows divide groups. For rosters and programmes where the data is the design.

Full-bleed bands alternate the page ground and a 2-4% tint, 96-120px padding, same rail inside, rails and guides unbroken across the change, optional 1px hairline. Cards take the opposite tone of their band. Contrast stays low so the page reads as continuous.

One ground from nav to footer, no dividers or tints. 160-240px of empty page between dense, hairline-carded modules. Hierarchy comes only from type size. Pages can run 14,000px without feeling crowded, provided the modules themselves are tight.

One unit repeats identically and replaces section headings: 1px rule, 100px clear, label, claim, body, plate. Or 400px cover, 20px gap, 36px title, 16px gap, 24px author row, 66px gap. Or photo, 70px gap, 63px paragraph, link, 2px rule, 66px gap.

Long light runs broken by an edge-to-edge black block at least one viewport tall (about 950px), dense with product, no gradient at the boundary. Fixed nav flips colour exactly at the cut. Most pages use one block, 25-50% of the way down.

Full-bleed flat grounds butt with no gutter, gradient or rule. Each 500-700px block holds one headline, one product, one action. Five to seven grounds from one limited set. Images may overlap seams. The colour change is the only divider.

The whole page changes ground and ink per chapter, each a designed colourway such as slate on pale blue or red-orange on peach. Scroll crossfades between rooms, cards stay one constant off-white. Four or five rooms at most, long-form reports only.

Sections meet on 40-80px radii: each colour's bottom corners round over the next, using z-index and a negative top margin equal to the radius. No straight edge wherever colour changes. Contents must change shape per sheet, never a left-right zig-zag.

Two widths alternate on one axis: 1392px edge panels and 1184px contained blocks, radius 16. About 120px between chapters, only 24px between stacked panels so related panels fuse. No full-bleed bands; the page reads as stacked plates.

A 1024px column steps through one full panel, then two 500px panels, then three 325px text panels, 24px gaps, each group opened by a centred H2 with 120px above. Shape changes while fill and radius never do.

Each screen is a 100vh full-bleed image with one title and at most one action. No section padding, headings or body copy. Scenes butt with zero gap, or rest on 270px white bands. Whole site may be only 3,000-5,000px tall.

A one-sentence or wordless row splits product modules: 112/115 three-line statement, left aligned, 150px above and below; or a 320px row of objects restating the motif. Use once or twice, so the page reads as an argument, not a feature list.
Dark and light sections meet on a shallow elliptical arc, 14px rise across 1000px, one clip-path curve reused at every colour change. Keep it barely visible; a deeper curve reads as a 2016 template.

Secondary plan families collapse to 56px headings with a plus, about 266px tall between full-bleed hairlines; heading takes the accent on hover. Keeps a pricing page short while the whole catalogue stays scannable.

One 580-640px column on an empty page, no nav bar, cards or rules. 100-170px above the first line, 55-80px between groups, about 90% plain ground. Gaps alone separate identity, statement and record, so type must be excellent.

Plain ground, one image per viewport and 60-66% empty, 120-260px between objects, no dividers or tints, at most one caption per screen. Margins stay blank for the whole scroll so photographs read as hung on a wall.

Document height equals the viewport. Everything sits on one axis or in one 856px column, 250-317px clear around the centre group, link rows 45px from top and 58px from bottom. No logos, stats or sections; depth lives behind links.
All UI pinned to the edges of an empty field: wordmark top left, timestamp top centre, small mark top right, 12px blurb bottom left. The centre stays empty for one live object.
Each scroll stop holds one centred element on a plain ground, about 200px vertical gaps, over 60% empty, central column about 430px, optional anchors at 35px margins. No rules, tints or cards.

One short 20px/500 label per section in a 360px left column that otherwise stays blank down the page, leaving a third of the container empty. The void is structural and constant, reading like a printed index.

In a tall text panel use only the lowest third: 13px paragraph, headline, small thumbnail, action, all bottom aligned, upper two thirds plain, so emptiness matches the neighbouring photo's area. Or tall cells with title at top, 140px gap, images on a shared base.

One 14px centred line at y=270, 12px grey line 30px below, then 300px of nothing before 870px-wide imagery. The contrast is 14px type against full-width images. No display headline anywhere on the first screen.

Between long runs, one near-empty viewport: a single title or three-line heading with 380-600px empty around it, no chrome. Works as a breath before a finale or between projects. Two or three on a page at most.

Ordinary sections on wide air: 96-160px between sections, 120px around centred 500px intros, side margins 40-133px, no cards, borders or tints. Hierarchy from size and hairlines. One canvas from nav to footer, bookended by a dark strip.

Viewport splits 40/60 on a 1px rule. Left panel stays fixed with logo, headline, actions and footer links; right column scrolls as a document. Panel needs a resident object. Also 50/50 colour panel with scrolling plates, or 1044px canvas with 348px side sheet.

Images never share a row: two 580px images with tops offset 180px, then widths change to 553, 453 and 933 centred, left edges stepping x=100, 760, 252. Gaps 120-200px, caption under each. Two objects per viewport for commerce, one for a gallery.

Each section changes which edge the photo bleeds from: widths 700, 852, 816, or 42% of the viewport, with the text's left edge jumping to match and 260px of ground between. Photos start partway down the previous block, so the page descends as a staircase.

706px image and 660px flat panel overlap: panel starts 65px below the image top and covers its right edge, with a stepped tab on one top corner. Rows swap sides. Hard corners, no shadow. Or photos hanging 290px past offset colour blocks.

An image or card row starts on one ground and overlaps about 140px into the next, offset from the copy column. It joins two sections and gives depth with no shadow. A first card row can rise 40px over a hero's bottom edge.

Section boundary is a 6-degree slope from tint to white, no rule. At the right edge flat accent parallelograms ride the cut and overlap, mixing where they cross, echoing the hero quietly. Once or twice on a page.

Section flips to black: left half a 40px grey caps statement, right half two offset photo columns, radius 8, scrolling at different speeds, leaving staggered bottom edges against the light section below.

Headline at the left 32px margin and action at the right 32px margin, on one horizontal axis at y=450 of a full-bleed image. The subject fills the span between. The same layout repeats on every screen.

The site is the product's own shell. Document locked to the viewport: menu bar, icon columns, 1140x800 24px-radius window scrolling inside. Or one pitch card, then the real feed for 4000px with the pitch returning mid-feed. Needs a product with a personality.

Overlapping photos, a 45-degree hatch block and small data tiles above; essay column below starts off-centre at x=644, 36px heading over 18/27 text. The collage breaks the grid once so the essay can stay strict.
Cards from 216x114 to 570x380 on a strong ground, 20px gaps, ragged left edges at five x positions, a stepped silhouette like posters on a wall. Every card is a link. For clubs, venues and culture.

The page's only saturated field: full bleed, one viewport tall, 64px two-line sentence bottom left, nothing else. Add grain or a dissolving edge and let dark product shots overlap its top and bottom edges, or it reads as a flat poster.

One full-bleed dark room in a light page: deep ground with two soft colour glows, 48px heading, tinted lede, 640px panel, 24px radius, 1px tinted border, caps labels. For trust, privacy and security. Surfaces step up inside; type system stays the same.

Chapter starts on a 6-degree edge, clip-path with a 10.5vw rise. Two or three flat strips ride the cut at the right and overlap. Accent switches for this chapter; panels raise one step with a 1px border. Without the strips it reads as a 2014 template.

Edge-to-edge panel cut by a 60-degree diagonal: deep ground to black at left, white to grey at right. Two products overlap the cut, 47px/500 names at opposite sides, underlined actions. For comparing exactly two things.

Full-bleed section with a non-straight top: left third rises 80px, centre recessed, right third 20px higher, hard 90-degree steps at x=326 and x=1070. Replaces any wave or gradient. Repeat the step in panels so it is a system.

Edge-to-edge still on black between light sections, no card or overlay gradient; white 45px headline left, small text in a right column. Or 100vh scenes stacked on hard cuts, both images sharing a ground so the seam stays calm.

Full-bleed photo pinned at 100vh while a 770px flat card scrolls up over it, holding small eyebrow, 40px heading, lede, action and a second image. Text never sits on the photo. Hold for one or two viewports.

Dark chapters are sheets, not bands: 1416px wide, 12px margins on a pale page, radius 20, inner panels one step lighter with radius 20. Light and dark overlap as stacked cards with no hard horizontal seam.
White page, 15px frame, 56px header row and 60px footer row hold all text; one 1410x780 photo fills between. Page height equals the viewport, so nothing scrolls away.
A 1360x698 photo, radius 8, centred across the join between a colour band and the page, the band ending 40% down the image. Gives the colour change depth without shadows.

One centred 580-640px column for everything: bio, rows, media. On 1440 that is x=400-1040. Index rows split it into three columns at 224 pitch. Optional 1px dashed side rules and 48px inner padding. Pages often under 1600px tall.

One width for all chrome and content: 896, 980, 1046 or 1300px. Nav, cards, tables, FAQ and footer hit the same two x positions; bands change colour but content edges never move. Optional 1px boxed side rails. This constancy produces the calm.
Up to four widths on one centre axis, stepping with reading density: nav 1084, pricing 1200, FAQ 944, switch 672. Or a 1024 frame with a 672 measure sharing a left edge. Wide is about 2.2x narrow.

All text and rails start at x=230 on a 980px column. Galleries start on that line and bleed only rightward past the viewport, scrolling sideways, so the left edge stays one line down the page. The next image peeks in to signal scroll.
Primary content runs the full viewport inside 16px margins with hairlines margin to margin; labels and secondary blocks indent to x=134. That second axis gives structure without any container.

Content column x=469-1232 sits right of centre, balanced by a date rail in the left third. Title, cover, heading and author share one left edge; search aligns to the right edge. Nothing breaks the column.

Shell in a 2-3% tint; 56px header and 260px sidebar sit directly on it. White content pane, radius 16, 1px line, inset 8px from right and bottom, scrolling inside. Article measure 672px. The article reads as a raised sheet.
1000px column of flat blocks on 10px gaps: 60px header strip, bio panel, five rows, action panel, one-line footer. The whole site nearly fits one viewport at about 950px tall.

Fixed 924px column centred on pure black with 258px empty gutters at 1440, no fluid scaling. Surfaces step #000, #0c0c0c, #0e0e0e, #151515. Dates the layout on purpose; for archives and culture sites.

Fix one time of day, one light direction, one colour bias across every subject, so warm-cool spread stays under 10 even if brightness swings. Crop to two ratios at most. Lift blacks 7-9%, hold highlights under 96%, saturation about 70%. Dusk amber for drama, matte daylight for calm.

Shoot on the page palette: ground, wardrobe and props drawn from its neutrals and accent. Grade seamless backgrounds to within 2-4% of the page colour so edges melt. One image per viewport or one-row colour story, flat frontal framing, no text on images, no borders.

One object on one coloured seamless, single soft key from one side, long soft shadow, shallow focus. Object fills about 50% of tile width, same scale across all tiles. Every tile shares one tone range. Ground colour carries the identity; no props unless they repeat.

Transparent cut-out on the exact tile colour, no floor line. Overlap colourways so the group fills about 90% of tile width, one soft contact shadow. Knolled parts in a loose grid on flat colour also work. Packs may rotate -12 to +15 degrees. Clean mask or do not use it.

Crop tighter than feels safe: object cut by the frame on two sides, texture left unretouched. Natural side light, square corners or one 12-20px radius across the set. Alternate macro with one frontal or wide frame for scale. No overlay, no caption inside the image.

Real moments, not staged: hands, gesture, equipment in use, wide places with small figures. One tile recipe across all frames: radius 8-24px, 16:10 or 4:5, caption below at 12-14px. Vary shot distance tile to tile. No grade toward brand colour if honesty is the point.

One camera position repeated exactly: overhead, same pale ground, soft window light, subject filling about 85% of a square or 4:5 tile. Radius 12-16px or square with 8px gaps. Captions under the frame at 12-14px. A single different angle breaks the set.

Plan images in pairs: neighbours contrast in tone or scale, never subject. Black-and-white grain beside saturated studio colour, macro beside wide, dark tile diagonal to light tile. Butt frames with 0-2px gaps. Photography supplies all page colour. No scrims, no filters.

Edge-to-edge or 20-32px radius panel. Subject composed to one side, copy on the open dark area at the page gutter, no scrim. Zone luminance spread under 0.04; white contrast at least 7 for body, 3.5 for 30px-plus display. If the zone fails, change the frame.

Native ratio, no radius, shadow, tint or inner caption. Fix one dimension: height up to 720px for a sequence, or a 330-420px column with unequal heights for an index. Interface stays neutral so all colour comes from the work. Caption below, 13px, centred or left.

Subject shot on true black, masked to a 570×760 vertical ellipse in a 720px panel, 2-3px bevel so the edge reads as cut paper. Mirror two per row. Or encode meaning: equal-height ellipses of varied width forming a waveform. Hard-edged subject only, never a feathered photo.

Candid prints tilted 1-2 degrees, up to 8 for scrapbook, overlapping each other and the headline base by 10-20px. Two sizes such as 450×300 and 258×335. One physical cue: clear tape, slide mount or 3px white border, soft 2-6px shadow. Keep one element perfectly straight.

One construction repeated: hard rectangles butted and overlapped with no radius or shadow, one colour story; or a context plate with a smaller flat artefact on top; or torn-paper collage thumbnails at radius 4px or less. Interface stays neutral around it.

Inside a radius 16 tile, overlay product output on a real photo: 9px outline triangles and a few 28px radius 7 squares, 1-1.5px white, placed on detected corners, never at random. Or one drawn 5px route ending in a dot. Choose frames with structure across the image.

Apply one screen to every photo: a 3px checker of two tints of the local colour, ±5-15% amplitude, slight hue split, at display resolution. Or 20px mosaic tiles, 2px gap in a darker copy of each tile, outline stepped in 3-5 tile blocks. No untreated photos beside it.

Greyscale first, then map shadow, mid and light to three palette stops so any photo lands in the same inks. Keep stops at least 60 L* apart so faces read. Pair with flat shapes in the same colours. One map per page. Plain black and white is the quiet form.

30-degree isometric plates, cubes and fins, 1px strokes at 13-34% ink, fills equal to page colour for occlusion, hidden edges dashed 2-3 at 10%. One element may have mass or colour. About 280px wide in a three-column row, small mono figure label above.

Plan-view line glyphs in one 96px box, one 1px stroke at about 34% ink, square terminals. 6px filled squares mark live nodes, dashed lines optional parts, fainter strokes secondary ones. Ten per grid, one cell lit to 78% with accent corner ticks. Accent only on what is live.

Flat accent fills, 1.5px ink outlines, white shapes, small second-colour dots, open-chevron connectors, on 20px grid paper at 6% ink in 300×190 cells. Objects overlap, connect, and one crops at the cell edge. One recurring motif marks the key node. No gradients.

1px grey wireframe at about 330px with centre lines, arrowed extension lines and rotated 12px mono dimensions, then cross-fade to the real object at identical position and scale. Or a large axonometric with neighbours pale and only the project tinted. Real dimensions only.

Draw at one-third size, ordered-dither along one colour ramp per material, one-pixel silhouette in an accent, display at exactly 3x with pixelated rendering, transparent on page. Or a dot globe: 4px dots, density shows land, about 800px wide, cut flat at the base.

A template, not fifty images, generated from data. Deep two-stop gradient, logo top-left, 118px gradient numeral, 19px caption, radius 8. Or grey collage: parts cropped off the frame, three scales, one dither band, one flat hue per cover, tiny corner marks, covers 3px apart.

Flat tinted panel, five to seven wandering lines one step lighter, 4-6px wide, running off every edge, never crossing, no closed loops. Isolines of warped noise plus a directional ramp. One field per tile. Keep type off it, or on a solid chip.

Strict structure, slight tremor: 1.25-2px near-black line, 60-100px, pale filled nodes or patches as the only tone, at most one flat colour. Let the drawing encode meaning, such as branches multiplying per tier. Keep to margins, tiles and emblems, never behind text.

One constant 1-1.5px line, no fills, running down the page and knotting into spot drawings at key sections, crossing section joins, flipping colour on dark bands. Or one 1280px pen drawing carrying small white callout tiles. Type indents to clear it.

One or two inks. Stippled plates about 600px with edges dissolving by grain into the ground, unframed, one per product; or 100px ink heads, colour kept in nearby labels. Same grain and palette across the series. Reuse as crest, avatar or watermark. Use real or public-domain sources.

Hold one medium: grainy ink with saturated flats, or gouache figures without outlines, or watercolour bleeding into white. Frames about 416×256, spots about 150×100. Fills sit slightly out of register. Figures overlap layout edges. Real art or tightly style-controlled generation only.

Plan three scales from the start: logo, spot, closing scene. One simple construction, thick 3px outline or no outline, flat fill in the brand accent. New pose per section, always overlapping a panel edge, never centred in a slot. Spots 230-300px, inline 44-80px.

Flat shapes, no outlines or gradients, about six hues, same objects recurring from hero to footer. Shapes merge into section colours, so the page ends as a scene. Pastel panels at radius 16, or full-bleed colour. Grain or a second flat shade adds depth.

Flat vector objects with an even 5-8px keyline around the whole silhouette, no shadow, slightly rotated, tucked at section edges and clipped by the next section. Optional halftone burst inside. Bold-colour and expressive pages only.

Cut-paper scenes photographed or rendered with soft drop shadows on a flat saturated field. One subject per screen, centred, about 50% of height, one light direction across the series, slightly imperfect paper edges.

One library or one hand. 16px icon, 10px gap, 14px label, 32px row pitch, 1.5px stroke, round caps and joins, currentColor. A different glyph per row, never repeated ticks. Stroke halves in viewBox units at 32px so it stays 1.5 on screen.

Yes: 14px solid ink disc with a white tick. No: 11px thin cross in the third ink, so absences recede. Info: 14px pale dot. Dark form: 16px white circle tick, muted plus-circle for inherited rows. Rows 32-48px tall with 1px rules.

Replace bullets with 14px source marks, plain tick for generic rows. Payment marks 24×16, radius 2, 8px gaps, full colour in a neutral row. Or 16px outlined product glyphs, one hue each, as an index key at 29px pitch.

40px solid marks from two or three overlapping tones of one colour ramp, no strokes, no tile. Overlap draws the form. Sit on the column left edge, 12px above a 14px bold title. Ramp matches the hero. Never under 24px.

One solid container, one rule: 56px near-black hexagon with white geometric glyphs knocked out, no line icons. Or 80px squircle, radius 20, 1px light 10% border, glyph centred, 16px label below. Shape must echo the logo.

Turn a real product component into the icon container. Event chip form: 90×80, radius 6, pale tint, 10px saturated left bar, 1.5px line icon in that hue with about 47px of ink, six colours. Scattered in margins at staggered heights, never over text.

Redraw a dull mark set in the page's own device: bold silhouettes as 1px horizontal scanlines on a 3px pitch, about 35% white, 72px, in a four-cell hairline row with 14px grey labels. Echo the hero pattern exactly.

Draw on 16×16 and show at exactly 3×, 48px, crispEdges. Dark one-pixel outline, two or three flat fills, stepped edges, no anti-aliasing. The only illustrative colour on an otherwise neutral documentation page.

Objects rendered with one setup: soft clay or gloss, top-left key, one contact shadow, same camera. About 48px, baked at 2×. Replaces flat glyphs in consumer navigation. Same family returns larger in modals and empty states.
44px pale embossed icons with white 14px labels and dark text shadow, 84px pitch down both screen edges over a wallpaper. Break the set once on purpose. Only inside a site built as a desktop.

State the mark in numbers: 3×3 solid squares at 13px, gap 3px, corner 2px, 44px total, with a pixel-fitted 16px master. Or an 80×88 outlined box, 2px stroke, one sheared corner, three rows of tracked capitals. Scales unchanged, inverts cleanly.

Name in the dealt type at -.025em, plus one device with a reason: a .42em dot that repeats large on product, .075em bars on chosen letters, or a 13px version number in a 1px chip. Must survive at nav size and pay off large in the footer.

Letters from square modules on a 5-high grid, no curves or anti-aliasing, crispEdges. Width always a whole number of modules. Nav about 154×26, large as art, one letter in a 64px radius-12 tile for product icons. Panels and notches share the same grid.

One clean cut through heavy letters: a hairline horizontal slice at about 34% of cap height, stencil gaps in bowls, or a diagonal slash taller than the letters splitting two colours. Cut is at least 1px at the smallest size, and only where strokes are wide.

One 1-1.5px stroke, oval 65×85 fixed bottom-left or 105×135 in the footer. Tracked caps on a path round the ring, two display letters at the centre. Below 40px, drop to the ring and one letter. The page's one decorative object.

Solid rectangle pinned to a page corner: 80×50 with a two-line 14px bold wordmark at a 6px inset, square corners; or a fixed 150×225 tab flush top-left that overlaps every section. Supplies the page's one strong colour.

Redraw the mark per scale, never just resize it: 58px seal in nav, 40px footer, 560px flat mid-grey version with heavier strokes as a whole band. Reuse as divider, placeholder, overlay and closing wordmark, and put it on the product itself.

A custom pictogram per item inside one fixed container: 38px black square, white glyph drawn from the object itself, right-aligned above the title beside the image. Same weight and square throughout. Or larger square tiles as map pins. Needs at least six items.
One state change only: hero wordmark hands off to a 20px bar version past the hero; or a 50×36 mark of three bars shears through states with scroll; or logo and menu icon share one box and weight.

Squircle 100-255px, radius 17-24% of the side, one glyph or gem render, 1-2px lighter inner rim, light from one direction. Hero signature instead of an eyebrow, or a closing object straddling a band. Below 24px, use the glyph alone.

Reserved for one large moment: about 200px soft-bevelled mark rotating on scroll, a 176px twisted-ribbon letter above a reveal line, or a hard 6px extrusion on a heavy wordmark. Flat version everywhere else.
A hand-signed tag about 145px wide in one flat colour, repeated on loader, footer and product. Or die-cut wordmark stickers with a 16px outline, rotated up to 10 degrees, dropped in margins.

Isometric cubes, three flat tones, no gradient or texture. One lattice face per block, 5×5 thin bars in the block's tone, mostly mid-grey panes, a few dark; the other face solid, carrying small lettering. Lead block in the accent, its panes white, some recessed. Floor two pale tints.

CSS 3D at rotateX 55, rotateZ -40. Near-opaque top plate with real text, tinted base plate with code, two translucent side walls, dashed verticals, blurred accent glow beneath. About 640px scene. Or one 220px glass cube among 40 grey tiles to mark one item.

145px tile, radius 36, dark gradient, 1px inner light. One glossy object at 65% of the tile, lit by a coloured strip in the environment, thin glow along the base, one hue per section. Centred 30px above headings. Or a 763×400 cover with one chrome-black object at right.

Pure black ground, no floor, no glow. Thin grazing strip lights plus dim soft boxes, satin metal at roughness about .38, knurling, bevels and micro-lettering. Long lens, 22-degree field. One object or a tight rhythm about 800px wide. One hue on one element only.

One matte tone over everything, soft even light, visible ambient occlusion, no texture. About 650px object on a bare same-tone ground, rotating with scroll, or a full clay scene with faint labels. Small coloured mono labels are the only colour.
A 3D part rotates, then flips to line art at exactly the same position, scale and angle as the section ground changes. One moment per page. Use an edge pass or two registered images.

Parts separated along one axis with equal gaps, lit from above, one soft shadow under the last part. Small numbered black dots on near-white, with the numbered specification in small caps below. Or silver plates with one accent plate, about 280px, reused as one object family.

Object about 1000px wide cropped by its tile, no device frame, tilted about 20 degrees, lit from upper left so every small form casts a shadow. Micro-grain, legible lettering. Copy-free chapter, or sits straight on a grain-filled tile.

One material truth, lit for it: ribbed knit under soft even light with no cast shadow, base fading into the page; or matte black hardware where labels supply all colour, tumbling 30-40 degrees; or a glossy floor with a long reflection. UI may sit on the reflection.

Form with structure and grain: 150-400px spheres with hard colour facets, heavy film grain, dark terminator, soft contact shadow, no two alike, crossing section edges. Or one 1340px ribbon of 1-2px streak lines with an edge dissolving away. Not a soft glow.

Object rotated 15-20 degrees with one soft shadow, centred on flat colour. Fan cards at about 15 degrees on black, or etch thin brand lines into a white slab. Extreme crops on soft grey lift it. Prefer a real cut-out photograph when available.

Small soft 3D characters about 70px, two-mark faces, one shared light and shadow, reused inside labels and diagrams so they read as recurring agents. Vinyl gloss at 130-190px on dark for agencies. Never hero-size without real character work.

Make footage nearly abstract: heavy horizontal motion blur, faces never sharp, or slow macro in near black with one edge light. One saturated note at most. Radius 16 in a panel or full 100vh. Type or a translucent UI card sits directly on it, no scrim.

100vw, about 830px tall or 100vh, hard crop top and bottom, autoplay muted loop. One 36px ring pause control top right, 20px inset. No captions, or white type straight on a set whose palette guarantees contrast. Poster set, reduced motion shows it.

Small muted 16:9 loops of 2-6 seconds replacing stills, one frame recipe, no player chrome, caption beneath at 12-14px. Palettes differ tile to tile, which makes the rhythm. Play only tiles in view, poster otherwise.

Lifestyle footage in a radius 42 frame. Two-line 24px white caption with a 28px app-icon chip placed in a calm part of the scene, as if the product spoke. 32px round controls bottom right. One line per shot.

Strong still, no scrim, one frame radius. Play drawn from your system: 84px square, radius 12, page-surface fill, thin outline triangle; or 90px solid accent circle with white triangle; or 72px frosted orb. Centred. Load the player only on click.

Column-width clip about 624px, radius 8, 1px border at 6%. Controls inside the frame: play, volume, 13px tabular time, 3px scrubber, remaining time, fullscreen, white with no panel. On bright footage add a 64px local gradient under the strip only.

Four tiles 288×440-480, radius 12, same framing. 80px translucent grey play disc at 36% height, blurred backdrop. Bottom scrim with 16px semibold name and one-line outcome in white. Or 322×570, 64px black circle, caption and shop link below.

Dark translucent card 202×240, radius 20, 32px inset at hero bottom right. Thumbnail 186×124, radius 12, 24px outlined play circle, 16px tight caption, 10px mono duration. A second story without a second button.

Real footage dimmed to about 55%, then real product output on top: one filled box on the lead object, 1px outlines on the rest, 10px labels on 15px tabs. Or black-and-white footage with chromatic fringing and word-by-word captions at centre.

Phone hero order: headline, sub, action, then one real object at full column width with its top 100 to 200px showing above the fold. 16 to 24px gutters, 36 to 48px headline on two to four lines. The cut edge says keep scrolling. The safe default for product pages.

Art leaves the side column and moves above the headline: a 300 to 340px object, then a 36 to 48px centred title, copy and action, all on one screen. Flip with CSS order so the source stays headline first. Use when the picture explains faster than the sentence.

The form is the hero on phones. Heading 36 to 54px on up to three lines, then 48px full-width fields set at 16px so iOS never zooms. Email and button may share a row. Secondary art moves below. For sign-up, booking, donation and search.

Full-bleed portrait photo or film at 84 to 100svh. Copy pinned low left at a 16 to 24px margin: 36 to 48px heading, one line, 44 to 52px button in thumb reach. Scrim only behind the text. Stop short of the fold so the next band peeks in.

The hero stays an object: a panel inset 8 to 20px from the viewport, radius 16 to 32, 76 to 94 percent of screen height. Copy centred or anchored low, buttons near its base. Margin and radius hold at every width. Only padding and type change.

Product window kept whole at 50 to 60 percent scale, left edge near the gutter, cut by the right edge and the fold, dimming away from the left. Show one focused document with three type sizes, not a table. Structure must read, words need not.

A centred object 230 to 260px wide with companions cropped by both screen edges, 40 to 65px showing each side. Make the stage wider than the phone, about 520px, and centre it with translateX. Reads as a wider world, not a squeezed row. For hardware, apps and auth.

Signature art survives by being cropped, not shrunk. A disc sized past the viewport leaves two arcs, a ribbon retreats into one corner, a mascot tucks top right, a glyph sits behind the headline at 320px. Size in vw, keep it out of the text zone, clip the section.

Drop the big window and put one small real moment in its slot: a 236 to 340px card with one prompt, one chart or one notification, on a glow or tinted plate, between hairlines. Never a shrunken full screen. It reads at phone size and loads faster.

The whole composition scales down unchanged: render, lockup and labels keep their positions at about 90 percent width. Only for stages with no small text, such as 3D renders, film and big lockups. Do not use it for interfaces, where 12px text turns to 5px.

The image is recut for portrait, not letterboxed. Serve a separate tall crop with picture and media at 700px, or set object-position per breakpoint. Crop tighter on the subject, 680 to 800px tall. Text moves into the space the new crop leaves open.

Same pieces, new arrangement, placed by hand for 390 by 844: robots fall into a diagonal, a wall of photos drops to two lanes, a diptych merges into one panel, title mid-screen, action low. Highest craft and highest cost. Worth it on one hero only.

When art only decorates, cut it. Keep headline, proof and action, raise the type one step, and let a hairline or the next section do the pacing. No illustration beats a 120px thumbnail of one. For text-strong docs and developer pages.

Swap what a phone cannot do for what it can. A desktop download becomes a disabled 42px pill pointing to a desktop, above a live sign-up button, or a button pair becomes an email field that sends a demo link. State the swap in plain words.

Buttons fill the column and stack: 44 to 56px tall, 8 to 16px apart, primary filled, secondary outlined, a trust line or text link beneath. Best for a single-goal conversion page. Only about 3 in 10 gold heroes do this, so treat it as a choice, not a rule.

Two buttons share one row, equal halves or inline, 40 to 48px tall, 8px gap, labels under 16 characters. Both actions land in one glance and it saves 56px of height. Test the longer label at 360px wide, and stack only if it wraps.

The button keeps its own width and holds the left edge: 44 to 54px tall, hugging the label, two stacked left if needed. Reads calmer and more premium than a full bar. The most common choice on gold sites. Best with strong imagery or a serif.

Fixed action at the foot, phones only, 56 to 72px tall with safe-area padding, opaque ground, top hairline. Either a pill plus text link, or one bar inset 12 to 16px. Reveal it once the hero CTA leaves the screen, and reserve matching page padding.

Keep two columns instead of one: tiles 165 to 188px wide, 4 to 12px gaps, square or 5:6, gutter down to 5 to 16px. Twice the density, more choice per screen, no carousel. Labels must fit 150px. For shops, categories, galleries and teams.

A collection becomes a sideways rail: cards 230 to 345px wide, 12px gap, next card showing 30 to 65px at the edge, scroll-snap to start, padding and scroll-padding equal to the gutter, scrollbar hidden. Any arrows 40 to 44px. For products, cases and events.

Grid falls to one column with the card anatomy unchanged: same radius, padding one step less, 12 to 16px gaps, full column width. Fixed heights go. Inner media stays at desktop size and is cropped by the card. Tile order follows reading order.

Cards dissolve into a ruled list: one column, 1px rules, each entry repeating one rhythm of meta, media, title and dek. Dates in side rails fold to a small line above the title. 24 to 34px after each rule. For news, changelogs, catalogues and directories.

One picture per row at column width, with the caption moved off the image to the page ground: 16 to 20px title, 12px caps meta, 30 to 40px to the next picture. At 2:1 three pictures fit a screen. For portfolios, architecture and galleries.
